strings.{actor} 一字一字地念完了。没人说话，所有人都看着曹国栋。: {actor} reads it out word by word. Nobody speaks. Everyone is looking at Gordon.
strings.{actor} 一把攥住了一丛箭竹，手心被划得全是血，人总算停住了。: {actor} grabs a fistful of bamboo; it slices the palm open, but the slide stops.
strings.{actor} 从一棵枯死的杜鹃树上劈下干芯，削成一卷一卷的木花，一点就着。火苗: {actor} splits the dry heart out of a dead rhododendron and shaves it into curls that catch at the first spark. At last the flames climb, and steam rises off everyone's clothes.

strings.{actor} 写了很长一段，存好，关了机，把手机揣进贴身的口袋里捂着。: {actor} writes a long passage, saves it, switches the phone off and tucks it into an inside pocket to keep it warm.
strings.{actor} 去坡下打水，脚下长满青苔的石板一滑，整个人顺着陡坡往下出溜，眼看: Going down for water, {actor} steps on a moss-covered slab that slides away underfoot, and {actor.he} shoots down the steep slope toward the boulders at the edge of the stream.
strings.{actor} 咬着牙一条一条往下拽，血顺着脚踝往下淌。: {actor} grits {actor.his} teeth and pulls them off one by one; blood runs down to the ankles.
strings.{actor} 哆哆嗦嗦地摸出吸入剂，深深吸了两口。过了好一会儿，呼吸才平下来。: Shaking, {actor} digs out the inhaler and takes two deep puffs. It's a long while before her breathing settles.
strings.{actor} 在山脊上举着手机转了一个多钟头，信号格一直是空的。: {actor} turns in circles on the ridge holding a phone up for over an hour. Not a single bar.
strings.{actor} 在溪边的石头上一脚踩滑，整个人摔进了乱石里。: {actor} slips on a rock by the stream and falls hard among the boulders.
strings.{actor} 在营地周围又转了一圈，没找到新的东西。: {actor} circles the camp again and finds nothing new.
strings.{actor} 在记录本的最后一页写下了罗德胜的名字。: {actor} writes Dennis Luo's name on the last page of the record book.
strings.{actor} 在雾里绕了半天，连山脊都没找到。: {actor} wanders in the fog for hours and never even finds the ridge.
strings.{actor} 在雾里踩空，从一段陡坎上滑了下去。: {actor} misses a step in the fog and slides down a steep bank.
strings.{actor} 在雾里踩进一个被落叶盖住的坑，崴了脚。: {actor} steps into a leaf-filled hole in the fog and turns an ankle.
strings.{actor} 在雾里转了一大圈，最后又看见了自己的天幕。: {actor} walks a long loop in the fog and ends up back in sight of the tarp.
strings.{actor} 往下走了一段，前面是一片钻不过去的箭竹林，只好退了回来。: {actor} gets a little way down before a wall of arrow bamboo forces a retreat.
strings.{actor} 找到一段野兽踩出来的小道，跟着走了几百米，就消失在箭竹里了。: {actor} finds an animal track and follows it a few hundred metres before it vanishes into the bamboo.
strings.{actor} 把带“裙子”和“杯子”的白菌子、灰黑的红菇都挑了出来，见手青单独: {actor} picks out every white mushroom with a skirt and a cup, and every grey-black brittlegill, and sets the bluing boletes aside to be cooked through.
strings.{actor} 把引火物团在手心里点着，护着它一根一根往上架细枝。冒了好一阵白烟: {actor} lights the tinder cupped in both hands and shields it, adding twig after twig. After a long spell of white smoke, the fire finally catches.
strings.{actor} 把手机递给曹国栋。他看了很久。: {actor} hands the phone to Gordon. He looks at it for a long time.
strings.{actor} 把拉链拉到下巴，什么也没说。: {actor} zips it up to the chin and says nothing.
strings.{actor} 把指南针托在手心里，指针晃了半天才停下。阿鲁压低了声音：“这里是: {actor} holds the compass flat in one palm; the needle swings for ages before it settles. Alu lowers his voice: "This is a bewitched hollow. The mountain spirit won't let people go. The old people say compasses spin here." Ethan says the internet says so too — "magnetic anomalies".
strings.{actor} 把指南针放在一块石头上，走开三步，指针稳稳地停在北。在雾里走直线: {actor} sets the compass on a rock and steps three paces away: the needle settles firmly on north. Nobody can walk a straight line in fog; you need this.
strings.{actor} 把湿袜子又套了回去。: {actor} pulls the wet socks back on.
strings.{actor} 把照片放到最大，和邓一鸣、曹国栋对着山形比了半天：“溪沟往下，就: {actor} zooms the photo right in and compares the ridgelines with the others for a long time. "Down the stream is that notch. That's a hydropower station."
strings.{actor} 把脚伸到火边，脚底慢慢有了血色，疼得直吸凉气。: {actor} stretches {actor.his} feet toward the fire; slowly the colour comes back to the soles, and with it a pain that makes {actor.him} hiss.
strings.{actor} 把记录本摊在膝盖上，对着坐标和等高线画了半天，最后用铅笔往东边一: {actor} spreads the book on {actor.his} knee and works over the coordinates and contour lines for a long time. At last {actor.he} points the pencil east: "The cattle trail is that way. Less than a kilometre."
strings.{actor} 抖得牙齿咯咯响，嘴唇发紫，手指不听使唤，连拉链都拉不上了，说话也: {actor}'s teeth are chattering, lips blue, fingers useless — {actor.he} can't even work a zip — and {actor.his} speech is starting to slur. This is hypothermia.
strings.{actor} 抬手一指：“这边。”: {actor} lifts a hand and points. "This way."
strings.{actor} 抱着一捆柴往回跑的时候，被水冲倒，在石头上撞了好几下，才被人拽了: Running back with an armful of wood, {actor} is knocked down by the water and bashed against the rocks before being hauled out.
strings.{actor} 抱着头一路滚到溪边，半天爬不起来。: {actor} rolls all the way to the stream with arms over {actor.his} head and lies there a long time before getting up.
strings.{actor} 拉着皮尺在雾里一棵树一棵树地量，嘴里报着数。没人说话。: {actor} runs the tape from tree to tree in the fog, calling out the figures. Nobody else says a word.
strings.{actor} 拿一根烧红的细枝一碰，蚂蟥就蜷成一团掉了下来。: {actor} touches each one with a glowing twig and it curls up and drops off.
strings.{actor} 指的那条沟越走越宽，大家都松了口气。: The gully {actor} chose opens out as you go, and everyone breathes easier.
strings.{actor} 按了删除，把手机揣回了怀里。: {actor} presses delete and tucks the phone back inside {actor.his} jacket.
strings.{actor} 挑了半天，手一直在抖——有几朵，{actor.ta}也说不准。: {actor} sorts for a long time, hands trembling — a few of them, even {actor.he} can't be sure about.
strings.{actor} 捧着一杯冒热气的水，慢慢不抖了。: Cradling a steaming cup, {actor} slowly stops shaking.
strings.{actor} 摸了摸那块铝牌，转身走了。: {actor} touches the aluminium tag, then turns away.
strings.{actor} 沿着崖顶往两边找了一圈，箭竹密得钻不进去，没找到下去的路。: {actor} works along the top of the cliff both ways; the bamboo is too thick to push through, and there's no way down.
strings.{actor} 的手在湿绳子上一滑，人顺着崖壁往下出溜了好几米，重重地撞在石头上: {actor}'s hands slip on the wet rope and {actor.he} slides several metres down the rock face, slamming into a ledge.
strings.{actor} 背着东西从一块湿石头上滑了下去，摔在了下面的乱石里。: Weighed down by a heavy load, {actor} slips off a wet rock and lands among the boulders below.
strings.{actor} 脱下泡了好几天的袜子：脚又白又皱，像泡烂了的豆腐，脚趾发麻，按下: {actor} peels off socks that have been wet for days: the feet are white and wrinkled like sodden tofu, the toes numb, and a pressed fingertip leaves a mark that takes ages to fade. This is trench foot — feet that rot without ever freezing.
strings.{actor} 被搜救队接下了山。: {actor} is brought down the mountain by the search team.
strings.{actor} 被断枝擦着砸在了头上，当场倒了下去。: A glancing blow from the falling branch drops {actor} on the spot.
strings.{actor} 被裹进救生毯，身边的人把冰凉的手脚夹在自己腋下。: {actor} is wrapped in a blanket; the person beside {actor.him} tucks the icy hands and feet into their own armpits.
strings.{actor} 被赶出了天幕，一个人走进了雾里。: {actor} is driven out from under the tarp and walks off alone into the fog.
strings.{actor} 跟着大家走出了林子。: {actor} walks out of the forest with the others.
strings.{actor} 跟着白秀英下了山。: {actor} goes down the mountain with Iris Bai.
strings.{actor} 跪在天幕外面的雨里，一口一口地往肺里抢气。: {actor} kneels out in the rain beyond the tarp, fighting for every breath.
strings.{actor} 蹲了下来，声音很小：“西坡……我不认得。”: {actor} crouches down and says very quietly, "The western slope… I don't know it."
strings.{actor} 隔一阵就举起手机看一眼。: Every so often {actor} holds up the phone and looks.
strings.{actor}在雾里认出了一棵树：树干上钉着一块生了锈的铝牌，是他八年前布设的一: In the fog {actor} recognises a tree: a rusty aluminium tag nailed to the trunk marks the centre of Plot 1, which he laid out eight years ago. The plots still to be measured are close by. He looks at the record book, then at everyone else.
strings.{actor}的手在包里摸到了那几根能量棒。宋佳怡就坐在旁边，嘴唇发紫，已经两天: {actor}'s hand finds the energy bars in her pack. Joy is sitting right beside her, lips blue, two days without a proper meal.
strings.{actor}的手机还剩一点电。他打开备忘录，想给未婚妻写几句话存在草稿箱里——: {actor}'s phone has a little charge left. He opens the notes app to write a few lines to his fiancée and leave them in drafts — just in case… He types a few words, then deletes them.
strings.{actor}的羽绒服吸饱了水，绒全结成了一团一团。原来鼓鼓囊囊的一件衣服，现在: {actor}'s down jacket is waterlogged and the down has clumped into lumps. What was a puffy jacket now clings like wet paper — wet down keeps no one warm.
strings.{actor}翻着相机里前天拍的照片，突然停住了：一张云海的照片里，远处山脊的缺: Scrolling through photos from two days ago, {actor} suddenly stops: in one shot of the sea of clouds, below a notch in the distant ridge, there's the faint glint of tin roofs, with a thin white line beside them like a road.
strings.{protagonist} 前两天好像缓过来了，今天早上眼白却发了黄，右边肋骨底: For a couple of days {protagonist} seemed to be recovering. This morning the whites of {protagonist.his} eyes have turned yellow, the pain under the right ribs won't let {protagonist.him} straighten up, and {protagonist.his} speech is starting to wander. Joy goes white: there was a death cap in that stew. Its poison attacks the liver, and it takes days to show.
strings.{protagonist} 喝一口吐一口，吐完再喝。: {protagonist} drinks a mouthful, brings it up, and drinks again.
strings.{protagonist} 对着火堆又说又笑。: {protagonist} talks and laughs at the fire.
strings.{protagonist} 突然开始扯自己的衣服，说热，热得受不了，一边说一边把: Suddenly {protagonist} starts tearing at {protagonist.his} clothes, saying it's hot, unbearably hot, and pulls {protagonist.his} jacket off as {protagonist.he} speaks, eyes unfocused. strings.{protagonist} 突然指着火堆边压低声音说：“你们看，好多小人，穿着花: Suddenly {protagonist} points beside the fire and whispers, "Look — all those little people in bright clothes, dancing…" {protagonist.his} eyes shine alarmingly; one moment laughing, the next shrinking back. Alu sighs: "Bluing boletes, not cooked through."
strings.{protagonist} 缩在火边，抖了一夜。: {protagonist} lies curled by the fire, shaking all night.
strings.{protagonist} 闹了半夜，又哭又笑，天快亮的时候才睡着。: {protagonist} rambles half the night, crying and laughing, and only falls asleep near dawn.
strings.“现在问这个有意思吗？”{actor} 的声音比谁都大。: "Does it matter now?" {actor}'s voice is louder than anyone's.
strings.一丛枯死的箭竹，竹竿里面是干的: A clump of dead arrow bamboo, dry inside the canes
strings.一个黑影从箭竹里蹿了出去，是一只麂子。: A dark shape bolts out of the bamboo: a muntjac.
strings.一兜石栎果，泡水去了涩才能吃: A pocketful of stone-oak acorns — edible once soaked to leach out the bitterness
strings.一半给阿黑，它也饿: Give half to Blackie — she's hungry too
strings.一堆菌子倒进了溪沟里，有人盯着水看了很久。: The whole heap goes into the stream. Someone stares after it for a long time.
strings.一定会受伤，但不至于要命: You'll certainly get hurt, but probably not killed
strings.一律烧开再喝: Boil all of it before drinking
strings.一截流着松脂的松明子，劈开里面是干的: A length of resin-soaked pine fatwood, dry inside when split
strings.一把小小的褐色菌子，看不出是什么: A handful of small brown mushrooms, impossible to tell what they are
strings.一捧野生越橘，酸得人皱眉: A handful of wild blueberries, sour enough to make you wince
strings.一支搜救队在几百米外发现了你们留下的痕迹，正往这边赶。: A search team a few hundred metres away has found the signs you left and is heading your way.
strings.一整天，信号格一次也没亮过。: All day long, the signal bar never lights once.
strings.一条狗翻那么多梁子，太悬了: Too much to ask of one dog, crossing all those ridges
strings.一条褪了色的红色标记带——是你们前天自己绑的。原来一直在绕圈子: A faded red marker ribbon — one you tied yourselves the day before yesterday. You've been walking in circles
strings.一条黑色的土狗，一只耳朵上有个缺口。跟着阿鲁在东坡放了五年牛，认得回寨子的路——: A black village dog with a notch in one ear. Five years herding cattle with Alu on the eastern slope; she knows the way home — if there is a way.
strings.一起唱，身上也暖和些: Singing together warms you up a little
strings.一锅一锅的水在火上烧开，晾凉了再灌进水壶。: Pot after pot is boiled over the fire, cooled and poured into the bottles.
strings.一阵大风灌进来，天幕的一个角“嘶啦”一声撕开了，雨水哗地浇在睡觉的人身上。: A gust slams in and one corner of the tarp rips open with a shriek; rain pours down on the sleepers.
strings.一阵狂风刮断了头顶的一根枯枝，正砸在拖柴的 {actor} 肩膀上。: A gust snaps a dead branch overhead and it comes down on {actor}'s shoulder as {actor.he} hauls wood.
strings.一面朝西的长坡，长满了石栎、木莲和杜鹃，树上挂满苔藓和松萝，林下是一人多高的箭竹: A long west-facing slope of stone oak, magnolia and rhododendron hung with moss and old man's beard, with head-high arrow bamboo below. A hundred-odd metres downhill runs a stream whose sound comes and goes in the fog; uphill, a ridge whose top you never see.
strings.七八百千卡的肉: Seven or eight hundred kcal of meat
strings.三个人把{protagonist}夹在中间，用救生毯连人一起裹住，一动不动地抱了: Three of you sandwich {protagonist} between you, wrap everyone together in an emergency blanket and hold still most of the night.
strings.下面有人回复：“他们顺着溪沟下到了一个小水电站，瀑布那一段是从左边的梁子绕过去的: Someone had replied: "They followed the stream down to a little hydropower station. They got round the waterfall by the spur on the left."
strings.不丢下一个人，把大家都带回去: Leave no one behind; bring everyone home
strings.不会那么巧，就这么着吧: It won't happen twice. Leave it
strings.不想让人知道；可哮喘发作是会要命的: You don't want anyone to know — but an asthma attack can kill
strings.不拖累大家；可他一个人缩在石头底下，撑不撑得到搜救队来，很难说: No burden on the group — but alone under that rock, whether he lasts until the searchers come is anyone's guess
strings.不湿身、不费力气；可柴不够的话，夜里火就会灭: Stay dry and save energy — but if the wood runs short, the fire will die in the night
strings.不疼，就是看着恶心: It doesn't hurt — it's just revolting to watch
