strings.不管它，明天还要走路: Ignore it — there's walking to do tomorrow
strings.不让任何人因为吃野生菌中毒: Don't let anyone be poisoned by wild mushrooms
strings.不费东西，可直升机隔着这么远很难看见: It costs nothing, but from that distance the helicopter will struggle to see you
strings.不费什么力气；可这时候外面还没人知道你们丢了: Costs nothing much — but nobody outside knows you're missing yet
strings.不走了，回溪边的营地等救援: Go no further; return to the stream camp and wait for rescue
strings.不走了，就在这里等救援: No more walking; wait here for rescue
strings.东坡寨子的彝族妇女，每年秋天赶着牛上山，住在牛场的窝棚里，一住就是两个月。她披着: A Yi woman from a village on the eastern slope who takes the cattle up the mountain every autumn and lives in a shack at the high pasture for two months at a time. She wears a woollen charwa cape; rain just rolls off it.
strings.东西保住了；可水涨得比人快: The gear is saved — but the water rises faster than people move
strings.东边那道梁子上找到了一条路：地上有新鲜的牛粪，箭竹被踩出一道一尺宽的口子，弯弯曲: On the spur to the east there's a path: fresh cow dung on the ground and a gap a foot wide trampled through the arrow bamboo, winding off into the fog. An old cattle trail, the kind herders use.
strings.丢的是面子，也许还有工钱: You'll lose face, and maybe the wages
strings.两个人一前一后，消失在牛路的拐弯处。: The two of them, one behind the other, disappear round a bend in the trail.
strings.两个人一起分担这一件湿衣服: The two of you share the burden of one wet jacket
strings.两个人只带了一壶水、一个打火机和一卷红布条，很快就消失在雾里。: Taking only a water bottle, a lighter and a roll of red ribbon, the two of them are soon swallowed by the fog.
strings.两个人带着柴刀和哨子，钻进了坡下的箭竹林。: Two of you take the machete and a whistle and push down into the bamboo below.
strings.两个人都不说话了。过了一会儿，曹国栋往火里添了一根柴。: Neither says another word. After a while, Gordon puts another stick on the fire.
strings.中午，云层忽然裂开了一道口子，阳光照进了林窗。每个人都把湿透的衣服、袜子、救生毯: Around noon the cloud suddenly tears open and sunlight falls into the clearing. Everyone spreads their sodden clothes, socks and blankets on the rocks to dry, and steam rises from them in wisps.
strings.也许它会自己走: Maybe it will leave on its own
strings.也许是个认得路的人，也许是个需要帮忙的人: Maybe someone who knows the way; maybe someone who needs help
strings.也许真的只是吃坏了肚子: Maybe it really was just an upset stomach
strings.云层抬高了一阵，山谷里传来一阵沉闷的轰鸣：一架直升机贴着对面的山脊飞了过去，又折: The cloud lifts for a while, and a dull roar fills the valley: a helicopter skims the ridge opposite, then turns back. The fog could close in again at any moment.
strings.云散开了一阵，阳光从树冠的缝里漏下来，对面的山脊看得清清楚楚。夜里会格外冷。: The cloud breaks for a while. Sunlight falls through gaps in the canopy, and the ridge opposite stands out sharp. Tonight will be extra cold.
strings.五个人排成一串，钻进了湿漉漉的箭竹林。: The five of you file into the dripping bamboo.
strings.人保住了；柴和东西会丢一半: Everyone gets out; half the wood and gear will be lost
strings.人肯定没事；吃的就没了一半: Nobody gets hurt — but half the food is gone
strings.什么也不浪费；可这一夜会很难熬: Wastes nothing — but it will be a hard night
strings.今天不动，养养力气: Stay put today and get your strength back
strings.从林子里拖回来的枯枝倒木，全是湿的，要在火边烘干才烧得起来。: Deadwood dragged in from the forest, all of it wet. It has to be dried beside a fire before it will burn.
strings.从湿滑的陡坡上摔落: fell down a slick, steep slope
strings.从溪边的乱石上摔落: fell from the boulders along the stream
strings.从瀑布边的石崖上坠落: fell from the cliff beside the waterfall
strings.他把路说得很清楚，一遍又一遍，像是怕你们记不住。你们走的时候，他还在后面喊：“记: He describes the way very clearly, over and over, as if afraid you'll forget. As you leave he's still calling after you: "Remember to send someone!"
strings.他接过救生毯，裹在身上，盯着你们离开，一句话也没说。: He takes the blanket and wraps himself in it, and watches you go without a word.
strings.他走不了路，要人照顾，也要吃要喝；可他认得路: He can't walk and will need looking after, food and water — but he knows the way
strings.会挨骂；可大家知道了真相: You'll get an earful — but everyone will know the truth
strings.会有人问：怎么现在才拿出来: Someone will ask why you didn't bring them out sooner
strings.你们在一棵四五个人才抱得过来的老石栎底下熬过了第一夜：一块天幕、三张救生毯、一堆: You got through the first night under an ancient stone oak so broad it would take four or five people to circle it: one tarp, three emergency blankets and a pile of smoking wet wood. The handheld GPS died yesterday afternoon, the phones have no signal, and the radio only hisses. All that's left to eat is the bit of food in each person's pack.
strings.你们把罗德胜的位置告诉了搜救队。一个小组立刻顺着溪沟往下去找他。: You tell the searchers where Dennis Luo is. A small team sets off down the stream at once to find him.
strings.你们是林草局的？老表，莫要报上去嘛。: You're from the forestry bureau? Cousin, don't report me, eh.
strings.你有哮喘。冷空气和烟一呛就会发作，包里的吸入剂只剩小半支。你没告诉任何人——怕队: You have asthma. Cold air or smoke can set off an attack, and your inhaler is nearly empty. You haven't told anyone — you were afraid the team leader wouldn't let you come.
strings.你跟曹队长说你走过西坡。其实你只在十几岁时跟着阿爸来过一次，路早就记不得了。你需: You told Team Leader Cao you'd walked the western slope. In truth you came here once as a teenager with your father and have long forgotten the way. You need the wages — your daughter starts high school in the prefecture town next term and you're still half the fees short.
strings.保住身上这点干衣服: Keep what dry clothes you have
strings.偷偷塞一根给宋佳怡: Slip one to Joy on the quiet
strings.傍晚，一串浑身是泥的人从林子里走了出来，走到了山下的路上。水电站值班的老师傅愣了: Toward evening a line of mud-caked people came out of the trees and onto the road below. The old man on duty at the hydropower station stared at them for a long while before he thought to pick up the phone. {aliveCount} people, every one of them. That night in the search headquarters tent, some people cried and some laughed.
strings.先把火生起来，把衣服烤干: Get a fire going and dry out first
strings.先抢柴火和东西，再撤: Save the firewood and gear first, then go
strings.先活着出去，账以后再算: Get out alive first; settle accounts later
strings.先派两个人顺着溪沟往下探一探，再决定: Send two people down the stream to scout before deciding
strings.全下锅煮了，大家分着吃: All of it into the pot; everyone shares
strings.全扔了，饿着也不冒这个险: Throw the lot away — better hungry than poisoned
strings.全给最冷、最弱的那个人: Give it all to the coldest, weakest person
strings.关了机，电就耗得慢了: Switched off, the battery drains slower
strings.再等一天，先把担架扎好: Wait one more day and finish the stretcher first
strings.写下来，然后关机省电: Write it, then switch off to save power
strings.写好纸条，让阿黑回去: Write the note and send Blackie home
strings.冷锋压了过来：大风裹着冷雨横着打，林子里到处是断枝落下来的声音，溪沟的水声变成了: The cold front is on top of you: wind drives the cold rain sideways, branches crack and fall all through the forest, and the stream has gone from a murmur to a roar.
strings.冷雨下个不停，天幕上的水一股一股往下淌，山脊那边在刮风。: A cold rain that won't stop. Water pours off the tarp in streams, and the wind is up on the ridge.
strings.几个人冲回去，把柴和背包一样一样往坡上扔。: A few of you dash back in and hurl the wood and the packs up the slope one by one.
strings.几个人跟着哼，调子跑得厉害，宋佳怡笑出了声。: A few of you hum along, wildly off-key, and Joy laughs out loud.
strings.几个人轮流背着他，在溪边的乱石上一步一滑地挪回了营地。他一路都在念叨：“东边那道: Taking turns to carry him, you slip and stumble back over the boulders to camp. He mutters the whole way: "That spur to the east, where there's a lot of dung…"
strings.几个野猕猴桃，小得像鸽子蛋，有几个已经软了: A few wild kiwifruit no bigger than pigeon eggs, some already soft
strings.几朵灰黑色的红菇，看着和能吃的差不多: A few grey-black brittlegills that look much like the edible kind
strings.几朵白净的菌子，菌柄上有个“裙子”，底下有个“杯子”: A few clean white mushrooms with a "skirt" on the stem and a "cup" at the base
strings.几朵菌盖有巴掌大的牛肝菌: A few porcini with caps the size of a palm
strings.几朵见手青，手一碰就变蓝: A few bluing boletes that turn blue at a touch
strings.几根能量棒和半板巧克力摆在救生毯上。有人看了{actor}一眼，没说什么，掰开分: The energy bars and half a bar of chocolate are laid on an emergency blanket. Someone glances at {actor}, says nothing, and breaks them up to share.
strings.几部手机和一个充电宝加起来的电。低温下掉得很快；上山脊找信号、夜里打手电都要用。: All the phones and the one power bank put together. It drains fast in the cold, and you need it to look for signal on the ridge or to flash a light at night.
strings.出发前一天，县气象局发了寒潮和降雨的预警短信，建议暂停进山作业。你看到了，没跟任: The day before you set out, the county weather bureau sent a text warning of a cold wave and heavy rain and advising against fieldwork in the mountains. You saw it and told no one — the inspection is at the end of the month, and if the three plots weren't finished the whole project would have to be redone.
strings.分开的人死得更多，这是搜救队的经验: Searchers know that groups who split up lose more people
strings.删掉，现在说这个没用: Delete it — there's no use in it now
strings.到了最后，它能救你自己的命: At the very end, they could save your own life
strings.前人的教训，也许就是活路: Someone else's lesson might be your way out
strings.前面一段已经探过了，走起来快些: The first stretch has been scouted, so the going will be quicker
strings.前面有瀑布，不值得冒险: There's a waterfall ahead; it isn't worth the risk
strings.加固天幕，挖好排水沟: Reinforce the tarp and dig drainage
strings.北坡寨子里的人，偷偷进保护区挖重楼——一公斤能卖好几百。三天前在溪边的石头上摔断: A man from a village on the north slope who sneaks into the reserve to dig paris root, which fetches several hundred yuan a kilo. Three days ago he broke his ankle falling on the rocks by the stream, and he has been huddled under a boulder ever since, living on a bag of cold corn rice and stream water.
strings.十一月中旬，省林草调查规划院的一支小队进了滇中一片原始森林保护区的西坡，补测最后: In mid-November a small team from the provincial forestry survey institute went into the western slope of an old-growth forest reserve in central Yunnan to finish the last three survey plots: team leader Gordon Cao, technician Ethan Deng and graduate student Joy Song, with Alu, a Yi guide hired from a village on the far side of the mountain, and Sabrina Su, a photographer the reserve had commissioned to shoot a promotional film. Yesterday afternoon Sabrina said there was a shortcut along the ridge — and a chance to shoot the sea of clouds. Somewhere along it, the fog came in and the path ran out.
strings.半夜，天幕外面的箭竹里有东西在走动，咔嚓咔嚓地踩断枯枝。手电照过去，十几米外，一: In the middle of the night something is moving in the bamboo outside the tarp, snapping dead sticks underfoot. The torch beam finds a pair of green-glowing eyes a dozen metres off, then a big dark body — a black bear, drawn by the smell of food.
strings.半夜，溪水的声音突然变了——轰隆隆的，像有卡车开过来。手电一照，浑黄的水已经漫上: In the middle of the night the stream's voice changes — a rumble like a lorry bearing down. A torch beam shows muddy brown water already over the boulder bar, less than two metres from the tarp, with broken branches tumbling in it.
strings.原地等他们过来，先把伤员指给他们: Wait for them to come over and point out the injured first
strings.去林子里拖倒木、掰枯枝。这里的柴几乎全是湿的，要在火边烘干才烧得起来；只有还立着: Drag in fallen logs and snap off dead branches. Nearly all the wood here is wet and has to be dried by a fire before it will burn; only standing deadwood is dry at the core once split (more with a machete). In the rain you find less and get soaked, and it's easy to turn an ankle on the slick slope.
strings.又一天过去了，林子里除了雨声什么也没有。苏曼又提起了溪沟：“再这么等下去，等来的: Another day gone, and nothing in the forest but the rain. Sabrina brings up the stream again: "Keep waiting like this and all we'll get is colder weather."
strings.又一股洪水下来，一下子漫过了天幕。天亮的时候，大家趴在坡上，浑身是泥，柴火全没了: Another surge comes down and swamps the tarp in an instant. At dawn you're all sprawled on the slope, covered in mud, every stick of firewood gone.
strings.反问：现在追究这个有什么用: Snap back: what's the use of blaming anyone now?
strings.取材于云南哀牢山原始森林里多次发生的迷路和遇险事件。2021 年 11 月，一支: Drawn from the many cases of people lost in the old-growth forests of the Ailao Mountains in Yunnan. In November 2021 a four-person forestry survey team lost contact there; when they were found days later, all four were dead, and the official finding was hypothermia after being caught in extreme weather. It had been raining and foggy for days on the mountain, and the temperature had not actually fallen below freezing. The people and events in this scenario are fictional. The online myths about "magnetic anomalies" and "compasses that stop working" appear here only as something one character believes; what gets people lost is fog, a forest that looks the same in every direction, valleys with no signal, and judgement that gets worse by the hour.
strings.只喝天幕上接的雨水: Drink only rain caught off the tarp
strings.只救最需要的那个人: Help only the one who needs it most
strings.只能点一次；晴天里一柱白烟，几公里外都看得见: It can only be lit once; on a clear day a column of white smoke can be seen for kilometres
strings.只能点一次；白烟一起来，隔着雾也看得见: It can only be lit once; once the white smoke goes up, it shows even through fog
strings.各人包里剩下的干粮：几个饵块、半袋饼干、两根火腿肠、阿鲁的荞粑粑和一小块腊肉。: What's left in everyone's packs: a few rice cakes, half a bag of biscuits, two sausages, Alu's buckwheat flatbread and a small piece of cured pork.
strings.后半夜又掉下来一根，砸在了 {actor} 的肩膀上。: Late in the night another one falls and lands on {actor}'s shoulder.
strings.后半夜，{protagonist} 不见了。大家打着手电找了两个钟头，才在坡下的: In the small hours {protagonist} is gone. After two hours of searching by torchlight, you find {protagonist.him} in the bamboo downhill, soaked through, face and hands covered in cuts, still talking to the "little people".
strings.后半夜，{protagonist} 开始剧烈地呕吐、拉肚子，吐到后来只剩黄水，手: Late in the night {protagonist} starts vomiting and has violent diarrhoea, until there's nothing left to bring up but bile, hands and feet ice-cold. It's been ten-odd hours since the mushroom stew. A few others have stomach cramps too.
strings.后半夜，一阵暴雨顺着天幕的破口灌了下来，火堆“嗤”的一声灭了，柴堆也全湿透了。要: In the small hours a cloudburst pours through a gap in the tarp. The fire goes out with a hiss and the whole woodpile is soaked. To get a fire going again you'll have to start from tinder.
strings.后半夜，雾里隐隐约约传来一声喊，像人，又像什么动物。所有人都屏住了呼吸。: In the small hours a cry comes faintly through the fog — like a person, or like some animal. Everyone holds their breath.
strings.吐出来就好了，等它过去: Better out than in — wait for it to pass
strings.听阿鲁的，在大树下敬一敬山神: Do as Alu says and make an offering to the mountain spirit under the big tree
strings.吸入剂只剩小半支: There's not much left in the inhaler
strings.吹哨，拼命喊回去: Blow the whistles and shout back as loud as you can
strings.咬牙撑着，别给大家添麻烦: Grit your teeth and don't make trouble for anyone
strings.哨声一遍一遍地钻进雾里。: The whistle blasts go out into the fog again and again.
strings.唱的是什么，没人听得懂；可听着心里踏实: Nobody understands the words, but it's steadying to hear
strings.喊了半天，那边再也没有声音了。: You shout for a long time. No sound comes back.
strings.喊到嗓子都哑了，回应你们的只有滴水声和远处溪沟的水声。: You shout until your voices crack. The only answer is dripping water and the stream somewhere below.
strings.喝热水、吃点甜的，守着火: Hot water, something sweet, and stay by the fire
strings.嗡嗡声在头顶转了两圈，越来越远，最后什么也听不见了。: The buzzing circles twice overhead, then fades, until there's nothing to hear.
strings.回去以后，邓一鸣把队里所有设备的电池一块一块测了一遍，测出来六块不合格。他把报告: Back at the institute, Ethan Deng tested every battery in the team's kit, one by one. Six failed. He handed in the report and wrote his own name in the box marked "person responsible".
strings.在山里能做的只有这些；要活，得尽快被送下山: It's all you can do out here; to live, {protagonist.he} has to be got off the mountain fast
strings.在林窗正中垒一个大柴堆，底下塞干柴和松明，上面压满青枝和苔藓。听见直升机或无人机: A big stack in the middle of the clearing: dry wood and fatwood underneath, green branches and moss piled on top. When you hear a helicopter or a drone, light it and it sends up a column of white smoke.
strings.在林窗正中垒一个大柴堆，底下塞干柴和松明，上面压满青枝和苔藓，平时盖着救生毯。听: Build a big stack in the middle of the clearing: dry wood and fatwood underneath, green branches and moss on top, kept covered with an emergency blanket. When you hear a helicopter or a drone, light it and up goes a column of white smoke. Hard work.
strings.在林窗里用倒木和剥了皮的白树干摆三个十几米长的字母，中间铺满银色救生毯和红布条。: Three letters, each a dozen metres long, laid out in the clearing with fallen logs and peeled white trunks, the gaps filled with silver blankets and red ribbon. From the air, it's the only thing in this forest that doesn't look like trees.
strings.在湿漉漉的林子里转了半天，什么也没找到: Half a day in the dripping forest and nothing to show for it
strings.在溪沟里失足坠落: fell to their death in the stream gorge
strings.在牛路上一路绑红布条、摆箭头，留在原地等: Mark the trail all the way with ribbons and arrows, and stay put
strings.在这种湿度里，它多半干不了了: At this humidity, it probably won't ever dry
strings.在附近的林窗里用倒木摆一个大大的 SOS，把红色样地标记带一路绑到显眼的地方，把: Lay out a giant SOS of fallen logs in the nearby clearing, tie red survey ribbons wherever they'll be seen, spread the silver emergency blankets and weigh them down with stones. Once the camp is by the stream, lay it all out on the boulder bar, where it's easier to spot.
strings.在雾里从山脊的陡崖上坠落: fell from a cliff on the ridge in the fog
strings.在雾里，感觉往往是错的: In fog, gut feeling is usually wrong
strings.坐在火边砍杆子、绑绳子，扎一副能抬人的担架。有走不了路的人，就得靠它下山。: Sit by the fire cutting poles and lashing cord to make a stretcher that can carry a person. If anyone can't walk, this is how they get down the mountain.
strings.外向、能干、好胜，太相信自己的判断。出了事第一反应是想办法补救，坐着干等会让她发: Outgoing, capable, competitive, and too sure of her own judgement. When things go wrong her first instinct is to fix them; sitting and waiting drives her mad. She won't admit fault out loud, but inside she takes it harder than anyone.
strings.外面的搜救队离你们有多近、已经搜过了多大一片山。: How close the searchers are, and how much of the mountain they have already covered.
strings.多一个熟悉山的人；报信就晚两天: One more person who knows the mountain — but the alarm goes out two days later
strings.多等一天，换一个更有把握的决定: One more day of waiting, for a better-informed decision
strings.夜里谁也睡不着。阿鲁靠着树根，低低地唱起了一支彝族调子，调子很长，像在跟谁说话。: Nobody can sleep. Leaning against the roots of the tree, Alu starts to sing a Yi song under his breath — a long, slow tune, as if he were talking to someone.
strings.大家决定留在大树底下。探路的人一屁股坐在火边，半天没说话。: You decide to stay under the old tree. The scouts drop down by the fire and say nothing for a long while.
strings.大家又躺了回去，谁也没睡着。: Everyone lies back down. Nobody sleeps.
strings.大家在岔口坐了一个钟头，雾一点也没散。: Everyone sits at the fork for an hour. The fog doesn't thin at all.
strings.大家在瀑布顶上绑了一圈红布条，退回了营地。: You tie a ring of red ribbons at the top of the falls and go back to camp.
strings.大家在第一阵冷雨里来回拖了七八趟，天幕边上堆起了一人高的湿柴。: In the first cold squalls you make seven or eight trips each, and a head-high pile of wet wood grows beside the tarp.
strings.大家把人数、伤员、营地的位置说了一遍又一遍。她点着头：“晓得了。”: You tell her again and again how many you are, who's hurt and where the camp is. She nods: "I know."
strings.大家把包里能找到的最干的东西都翻了出来。: Everyone digs out the driest things they can find in their packs.
strings.大家把火边最暖的地方让给了{protagonist}。: The warmest place by the fire is given to {protagonist}.
strings.大家把红布条从营地一直绑到溪边最显眼的石头上，决定不再挪了。: You tie ribbons all the way from camp to the most conspicuous rock by the stream, and decide to move no further.
strings.大家把红布条又往外绑了一圈，在林窗里又加了几根倒木。: Another ring of red ribbons goes up around the camp, and a few more logs are added to the clearing.
strings.大家把能背的都背上，排成一串，踩着前几天开出来的路往下走。: You load up everything you can carry and file down the path you've cut over the last few days.
strings.大家抓起能抓的东西，连滚带爬地上了坡。回头看时，刚才睡觉的地方已经是一片翻滚的黄: Grabbing whatever comes to hand, you scramble up the slope on hands and knees. When you look back, where you were sleeping is a churning brown flood.
strings.大家抬头看了看，又低头缩进了天幕。: Everyone looks up, then ducks back under the tarp.
strings.大家拆了天幕，背着东西往坡下挪。到溪边的时候，每个人都湿到了腰。天幕在一块大石头: You strike the tarp and edge down the slope with everything on your backs. By the time you reach the stream, everyone is wet to the waist. The tarp goes up again behind a big boulder.
strings.大家挤成一团，听着撕开的天幕在风里噼啪地甩。: You all cram together and listen to the torn tarp cracking in the wind.
strings.大家有权知道: Everyone has a right to know
strings.大家站在天幕边上，看着她走进雾里。: You stand at the edge of the tarp and watch her walk into the fog.
strings.大家缩在天幕底下，听着水声，一夜没合眼。: You stay huddled under the tarp, listening to the water, and nobody closes their eyes.
strings.大家缩在天幕底下，听着那阵嗡嗡声远去。: You stay huddled under the tarp and listen to the buzzing drift away.
strings.大家缩在天幕底下，听着风一阵紧过一阵。: You curl up under the tarp and listen to each gust come harder than the last.
strings.大家缩在天幕底下，谁也不想动。: Everyone stays huddled under the tarp. Nobody wants to move.
strings.大家背起东西上了牛路，每走一段就在箭竹上绑一条红布。: You shoulder your loads and set off along the trail, tying a red ribbon to the bamboo every so often.
strings.大家背起东西，一个跟着一个，踩着前面的人的脚印往下走。: Loads on backs, you go down in single file, each stepping in the footprints of the one in front.
strings.大家趴在溪边，大口大口地喝。: Everyone lies down at the stream's edge and drinks deep.
strings.大家退回上游，从侧面的陡坡往上爬，抓着箭竹一寸一寸地挪。: You go back upstream and claw your way up the steep side slope, inching along by handfuls of bamboo.
strings.大家顺着探路的人踩出来的路，把营地挪到了溪边。: Following the path the scouts beat down, you move the camp to the stream.
strings.天一黑，雨就大了。湿柴怎么也烧不旺，冒出来的烟往天幕底下倒灌，熏得人直流眼泪；引: As soon as it's dark the rain picks up. The wet wood won't burn properly; the smoke rolls back under the tarp and makes everyone's eyes stream, and there's hardly any tinder left. To keep a fire alive through the night, something properly dry has to go in.
strings.天亮了，雾还是白茫茫一片。昨晚谁也没睡着：雨水从天幕边上往里渗，湿柴只冒烟不起火: Dawn, and the fog is as white as ever. Nobody slept: rain seeped in at the edges of the tarp, the wet wood smoked but never caught, and Joy shivered all night long. What first?
strings.天亮的时候，{protagonist} 好像缓过来一点了。: By dawn {protagonist} seems to have pulled through a little.
strings.天幕往坡下挪了二十米，搭在了一片没有枯枝的树冠底下。: The tarp moves twenty metres downslope, under a canopy with no dead wood in it.
strings.天幕被拆了下来，大家背着东西往溪沟挪去。: The tarp comes down and everyone edges toward the stream with their loads.
strings.天幕被重新绷紧，四周压上了石头，迎风的一面用箭竹编了一道墙，脚下挖出一条排水沟。: The tarp is pulled taut again and weighed down with stones, a wall of woven bamboo goes up on the windward side, and a drainage ditch is dug around it.
strings.太远了，别出去淋雨: It's too far off — don't go out in the rain
strings.失温不需要零下：湿透、吃不饱、累、穿着棉衣的人，在 5°C 的雨夜里体温也会一点: Hypothermia doesn't need frost: someone soaked, underfed, exhausted and dressed in cotton will slowly lose core heat on a 5°C rainy night. A hungry body has less fuel to shiver with, so it cools faster. A fire is the best medicine — but wet wood has to be dried beside a fire before it will burn, and every bit of tinder used is gone.
strings.失温的人最常说的一句话就是“我没事”: "I'm fine" is the commonest thing hypothermic people say
strings.头顶的雾里传来一阵嗡嗡声，忽远忽近——是无人机！外面的人真的在找你们。可是隔着树: A buzzing comes out of the fog overhead, now near, now far — a drone! People really are out looking for you. But can it see anything through the canopy and the fog?
strings.她一天一夜就能走到寨子；可这一路她也是一个人: She can reach the village in a day and a night — but she'll be on her own all the way
strings.她会走得慢一点，可能先救下一个人: She'll go a little slower, but it might save one person
strings.她把背篓往天幕底下一放，转身就去拖柴了。: She sets her basket down under the tarp and goes straight off to drag in wood.
strings.守在火边，把湿柴一根根架在火旁烤干，劈成细条往里添。火要是灭了、手边又没有干柴，: Sit by the fire propping wet wood around it to dry, splitting it into kindling and feeding it in. If the fire is out and there's no dry wood to hand, it takes 1 unit of tinder and a lot of patience to coax the wet wood alight — harder still in the rain — and wet wood smokes badly.
strings.宋佳怡一直这么说；可大家确实饿: Joy has been saying so all along — but everyone is genuinely hungry
strings.宋佳怡交上去的植物名录比计划多了十七种，最后一种是石栎——就是那棵大家靠着熬过几: The plant list Joy Song turned in had seventeen more species than planned. The last entry was stone oak — the old tree they leaned against through those nights. In the notes she wrote: diameter at breast height about 2.1 m; shelters five people from rain.
strings.宋佳怡后来每次出野外，都在背包最上面放两支吸入剂，第一天就告诉带队的人。她说那几: On every field trip since, Joy Song packs two inhalers at the top of her bag and tells the team leader on day one. The most important thing she learned in those days, she says, was to speak up when something is wrong.
strings.宋佳怡披着白秀英的察尔瓦，跟着她下了山。: Wearing Iris Bai's cape, Joy follows her down the mountain.
strings.宋佳怡捏着那根能量棒，看了{actor}一眼，背过身去小口小口地吃了。: Joy holds the bar, looks at {actor}, then turns away and eats it in tiny bites.
strings.宋佳怡没能回到学校。导师在实验室她的工位上放了一盆从山里带回来的苔藓，每天浇一次: Joy Song never made it back to the university. Her supervisor put a pot of moss brought down from the mountain on her desk in the lab, and waters it every day.
strings.宋佳怡的硕士论文换了题目，写的是滇中山地常见毒菌的识别。答辩那天，她在幻灯片的最: Joy Song changed her thesis topic to identifying the common poisonous mushrooms of central Yunnan's mountains. At her defence, the last slide was a photo of a pot of mushroom soup tipped out on the ground.
strings.宋佳怡被赶出去以后，裹着一次性雨衣坐在林子边上，一直坐到天黑。后来人们找到她时，: After being driven out, Joy Song sat at the edge of the trees wrapped in her disposable poncho until it got dark. When she was found, she had a stone-oak leaf clenched in her hand.
strings.察尔瓦给娃娃披着，我不冷。: Let the girl wear the cape. I'm not cold.
strings.对着照片和山形，推算那个方向: Work out the bearing from the photo and the shape of the ridges
strings.小炉子嘶嘶地喷着蓝火，湿柴一根根架在上面烤，冒着白汽。半罐气烧完的时候，火堆终于: The little stove hisses out a blue flame and the wet sticks steam on top of it, one after another. By the time the half-canister runs out, the fire is burning on its own.
strings.少淋一天雨；可下山就又晚了一天: One less day in the rain — but one more day before you get down
strings.山下，保护站的人等了一天一夜，调查队还是没有消息，对讲机也叫不应。站长拨通了县里: Down the mountain, the reserve station has waited a day and a night with no word from the survey team, and the radio goes unanswered. The station chief picks up the phone and calls the county.
strings.山东坡寨子里的彝族汉子，给调查队当向导和背夫，一天三百块。东坡的每一条牛路他都认: A Yi man from a village on the eastern slope, hired as the team's guide and porter at three hundred yuan a day. He knows every cattle path on the eastern side; this western side, he says he's been to. He has brought his dog, Blackie.
strings.山脊最高的那块石头上，{actor} 的手机突然跳出一格信号！电话只通了二十几秒: On the highest rock of the ridge, {actor}'s phone suddenly shows one bar! The call lasts barely twenty seconds — {actor.he} shouts the GPS coordinates into it before the signal drops.
strings.已经有几个人出现了重度失温的反常脱衣。: How many people have shown the paradoxical undressing of severe hypothermia.
strings.带一个人，花半天把这块样地补测完: Take one person and spend half a day finishing this plot
strings.带点昆明口音，爱说“按计划来”“我心里有数”“都莫慌”。: A bit of a Kunming accent. Likes to say "stick to the plan", "I know what I'm doing" and "nobody panic".
strings.带着大家自己走出森林: Lead everyone out of the forest on foot
strings.干净，可不一定够喝: Clean, but there may not be enough
strings.干活的人倒下了，大家都完了: If the workers collapse, everyone is finished
strings.开着飞行模式，每隔一阵关掉搜一次信号: Keep it in airplane mode and switch it off every so often to search for signal
strings.开路的人带回了好消息：再往下走两三个钟头，林子就到头了——下面有路，有房子，有人: The scouts come back with news: two or three more hours down and you're out of the trees. Below there's a road, buildings, people.
strings.开路的人说，下游那一段勉强能走。要不要全队收拾东西，再往下挪一段，到新的地方重新: The scouts say the next stretch downhill can just about be walked. Should the whole group pack up, move further down, and pitch the tarp again somewhere new?
strings.引火物烧完了，湿柴只冒了一阵白烟，火还是没起来。: The tinder burns away; the wet wood just gives off a puff of white smoke, and the fire never catches.
strings.当着大家的面念出来: Read it out in front of everyone
strings.当面问苏曼，她是不是早就看见了: Ask Sabrina to her face whether she saw it before
strings.往上爬两三个小时到山脊最高处，举着手机找信号。要用掉一截电量；山脊上风大，湿透的: Climb two or three hours to the highest point of the ridge and hold a phone up for signal. It costs a chunk of battery; the ridge is windy, so a soaked person chills faster, and in the fog it's easy to fall or take a wrong turn. Once the camp has moved down to the stream, the ridge is too far.
strings.往下翻，看看那两个人后来是在哪儿被找到的: Scroll down and see where those two were found in the end
strings.往火里压湿树枝，弄出浓烟: Smother the fire with wet branches to make thick smoke
strings.快，可伤口血流不止，容易发炎: Quick, but the bites keep bleeding and can get infected
strings.急救包夹层里的一板阿莫西林。: A strip of amoxicillin in the first-aid kit's inner pocket.
strings.所有人一起喊、吹哨，听听附近有没有人: Everyone shout and blow whistles — listen for anyone nearby
strings.所有人冲进林窗，把救生毯举过头顶拼命地抖。: Everyone rushes out into the clearing and shakes the emergency blankets over their heads for all they're worth.
strings.所有人出去拖柴，能拖多少拖多少: Everyone out to drag in wood — as much as you can
strings.所有人在林窗里又跳又喊。: Everyone jumps and yells in the clearing.
strings.所有人屏住呼吸，听着它在箭竹里窸窸窣窣地走动。: Everyone holds their breath, listening to it rustle through the bamboo.
strings.所有人挤在天幕最里面，裹着三张救生毯，阿黑趴在中间。谁动一下，所有人都跟着冷一下: Everyone crams into the back of the tarp under the three emergency blankets, Blackie lying in the middle. Whenever anyone moves, everyone feels the cold.
strings.所有人跑到林窗里，挥救生毯、挥红布条: Everyone run into the clearing and wave the emergency blankets and red ribbons
strings.所有能动的人去加大求救信号: Everyone who can move goes to make the distress signals bigger
strings.手持 GPS 的电池早就老化了，满电也只能撑半天。出发前你就知道，没换也没报——: The handheld GPS battery was worn out; even fully charged it lasts half a day. You knew before you set out and neither replaced it nor said so — and yesterday afternoon it died just as you left the plot line.
strings.手机只在少数山脊上偶尔有一格信号，电池在低温下掉得很快。一个报出坐标的电话，抵得: Phones only get the odd bar of signal on a few ridges, and batteries drain fast in the cold. One call that gets the coordinates out is worth days of searching by hundreds of people.
strings.手电光在雾里只能照出几米远。: In the fog the torch beam reaches only a few metres.
strings.手电光扫过去，几百米外的坡上也亮起了一束光，晃了三下。: The torch beam sweeps the slope, and a few hundred metres off another light comes on and swings three times.
strings.打着手电出去找: Take a torch and go out to look
strings.把{protagonist}挪到火边，裹严实了躺着: Move {protagonist} next to the fire, wrap {protagonist.him} up and keep {protagonist.him} lying down
strings.把三块样地的调查数据带出山: Bring the data from the three survey plots out of the mountains
strings.把力气全用在信号上；以后不再往下走: Put all your strength into signals; no more moving down
strings.把天幕的绳子重新拉紧，四周用树枝和箭竹叶围一圈挡风，地上挖条排水沟，再铺一层厚厚: Re-tension the tarp lines, build a wall of branches and bamboo leaves around it against the wind, dig a drainage ditch and lay down a thick bed of ferns. It can be done at night too, just more slowly.
strings.把最好的位置、最多的水都给{protagonist}: Give {protagonist} the best spot and the most water
strings.把最暖的衣服换给{protagonist}: Give {protagonist} the warmest clothes in camp
strings.把测绳和天幕绳结成一根，一个一个吊下去: Knot the survey line and tarp cords into one rope and lower people down one by one
strings.把湿柴摊开晒: Spread the wet wood out in the sun
strings.把火烧到最旺，把{protagonist}挪到火边: Build the fire up as high as it goes and move {protagonist} beside it
strings.把电留给大家：今晚打手电: Give the battery to the group: torch signals tonight
strings.把脚揣进别人怀里捂: Warm your feet against someone's belly
strings.把营地往旁边挪，离那几棵枯树远一点: Move the camp away from those dead trees
strings.把营地挪到溪边: Move the camp down to the stream
strings.把营地挪到溪边，再顺着溪沟往下找路: Move the camp down to the stream, then work your way down along it
strings.把袜子烤干，脚架在火边晾着: Dry the socks and prop your feet up by the fire
strings.把装吃的袋子扔远一点，让它去吃: Throw the food bag well away and let it eat
strings.抓住了就没事；抓不住……: Catch hold and you're fine; miss and…
strings.护住头，顺势滚下去: Protect your head and roll with it
strings.担架扎好了。几个人轮流躺上去试了试，杆子吱吱响，可是撑得住。: The stretcher is done. A few people take turns lying on it to test it; the poles creak, but they hold.
strings.拉脱水的人最怕冷: Someone losing fluids this fast gets cold very easily
strings.拖一拖，也许就不用说了: Stall, and maybe you'll never have to say it
strings.拿出吸入剂，告诉大家自己有哮喘: Take out the inhaler and tell everyone you have asthma
strings.拿出来分给大家: Bring them out and share them
strings.指南针没坏，是我们自己在绕圈。从现在起按方位走，每五十米绑一条红布: The compass is fine — it's us walking in circles. From now on, walk on a bearing and tie a ribbon every fifty metres
strings.指南针被塞回了口袋。: The compass goes back in a pocket.
strings.指对了没人知道；指错了……: Get it right and nobody need know; get it wrong and…
strings.按住{protagonist}，大家轮流看着: Hold {protagonist} down and take turns watching
strings.按住{protagonist}，把衣服重新裹上，几个人一起抱着{protagon: Hold {protagonist} down, wrap the clothes back on, and have several people hold {protagonist.him} close
strings.按规定记下来，出去以后上报: Record it by the rules and report it once you're out
strings.挑出来的菌子扔进了火里，剩下的煮了一锅汤。: The rejects go into the fire; the rest make a pot of broth.
strings.挤到没漏的那一半，天亮再说: Squeeze into the half that's still dry and deal with it at dawn
strings.掉得干净，伤口小: They drop off cleanly and leave small wounds
strings.探路的人回来了，浑身是泥：溪沟往下两三公里还走得通，再往下水声变得又闷又沉，像是: The scouts are back, plastered in mud. Two or three kilometres down, the stream can still be followed; further on, the sound of the water turns deep and heavy, as if it's falling from a height — maybe a waterfall. And in the mud by the stream they saw a line of footprints that aren't yours.
strings.搜救队一定已经在山里了: The searchers must be on the mountain by now
strings.搜救队也会沿溪沟找；可溪边更潮更冷: Searchers work the streams too; but it's damper and colder by the water
strings.搜救队员给每个人裹上保温毯，一个一个把人背下了山。{aliveCount} 个人: The searchers wrapped everyone in thermal blankets and carried them down the mountain one by one. {aliveCount} people, every one of them. The team leader said that in all the years they'd been searching these mountains for lost people, this was the first time they had found everyone alive.
strings.搜救队员给每个人裹上保温毯，灌下一口热糖水，搀着、背着，一个一个往山下走。: The searchers wrap everyone in thermal blankets, pour a mouthful of hot sugared water into each of you, and start down the mountain one at a time, propping up some and carrying others.
strings.搜救队和放牛人都走这条路，看见了就会找过来: Searchers and herders both use this trail; whoever sees the marks will come looking
strings.搜救队找到那块天幕的时候，火堆早就凉了。几个人挤在一起，身上盖着所有的救生毯；有: When the searchers found the tarp, the fire had long gone cold. The people lay huddled together under every emergency blanket there was; one jacket lay off to the side — at the very end, severe hypothermia makes people feel hot. In all those days, the temperature on the mountain never once fell below freezing.
strings.搜救队的医生先蹲到了伤得最重的人身边。剩下的人互相看着，有人笑了，有人哭了。: The search team's medic kneels first beside the worst-hurt. The rest of you look at one another; some laugh, some cry.
strings.搜救队终于找到了天幕底下的人。被背下山的是：{survivors}。留在林子里的: In the end the search teams found the people under the tarp. Carried down the mountain: {survivors}. Left in the forest: {dead}. Later, someone asked what had been hardest in those days on the mountain. The survivors thought for a long time and said: the cold. Always the cold.
strings.搜救队顺着脚印找到了在外面的 {actor}。: Following the tracks, the searchers find {actor}, who was out on their own.
strings.搜救：调查队失联第二天才会大规模进山。无人机的热成像穿不透浓雾和树冠，直升机在雾: Search and rescue: the full search only gets going on the second day after the team goes missing. Thermal drones can't see through thick fog or the canopy, helicopters can't fly in fog, and dog teams and ground crews work along streams and trails. The chance of being found depends on how far the search has got, how visible your distress signal is, and the visibility; people standing in a clearing or on the boulders by a stream are much easier to spot than people under the trees.
strings.撕样地记录本引火: Tear pages out of the plot record book
strings.收工回来脱鞋，每个人的袜子都是红的：旱蚂蟥钻进了裤腿、鞋帮和腰带底下，吸饱了血还: Back from the day's work, everyone pulls off their boots to find their socks red: land leeches have got up trouser legs, into boots and under belts, and are still burrowing in, gorged with blood.
strings.收拾东西，顺着牛路走: Pack up and follow the cattle trail
strings.救人要紧；他心里会记着: Saving lives comes first; he won't forget it
strings.救最需要的人: Save the one who needs it most
strings.数据可以再测，人不能再来: Data can be measured again; people can't be replaced
strings.数据能补齐；别人会怎么看: The data would be complete — but what will the others think?
strings.敲锅、吹哨、一起大喊: Bang the pot, blow the whistles, everyone yell
strings.无人机在头顶悬停了好一会儿，又压低了高度，灯一闪一闪——它看见你们了！: The drone hovers overhead for a long moment, then drops lower, its light blinking — it has seen you!
strings.早一天被找到，就多一分希望: Every day sooner you're found is a little more hope
strings.是麂子，别瞎折腾: It's a muntjac. Don't wear yourselves out
strings.普通话夹着彝语腔，常说“山有山的脾气”“莫着急”“跟着水走，会走到崖子上”。: Mandarin with a strong Yi lilt. Often says "the mountain has its moods", "don't hurry" and "follow the water and it takes you to a cliff".
strings.普通话说得不太好，句子短，常说“走”“莫怕”“跟着我”。: Not much Mandarin; short sentences. "Go." "Don't be afraid." "Follow me."
strings.晴天里的信号最显眼: Signals stand out best on a clear day
strings.暴雨把柴堆浇透了一截，烘好的干柴又成了湿柴。: The downpour soaks part of the woodpile; dried wood is wet wood again.
strings.曹国栋把那本泡得发皱的样地记录本交了上去，项目按时通过了验收。庆功会他没去。那年: Gordon Cao handed in the waterlogged plot book and the project passed its inspection on time. He didn't go to the celebration. That winter the institute brought in a new rule: all fieldwork stops when a weather warning is issued. He wrote it.
strings.曹国栋没能走出那片林子。他的记录本被交回了院里，最后一页是他在雾里写的：“全员平: Gordon Cao never made it out of the forest. His record book was returned to the institute. On the last page, written in the fog in a neat hand: "All well. Returning tomorrow." It is dated the following day.
strings.曹国栋的脸涨得通红，转身出去拖柴了。: Gordon flushes red, turns and stalks off to drag in wood.
strings.曹国栋看了{actor}一眼，把 GPS 塞回了包里。: Gordon gives {actor} a look and stuffs the GPS back in his pack.
strings.曹国栋看着那几页纸卷起来、变黑，一句话也没说。火苗腾了起来，湿柴终于噼啪作响。: Gordon watches the pages curl and blacken without a word. The flames leap up, and at last the wet wood starts to crackle.
strings.曹国栋终于没忍住：“要不是你那条近道，我们现在已经在保护站吃饭了！”苏曼也站了起: Gordon finally snaps: "If it weren't for your shortcut we'd be eating dinner at the reserve station right now!" Sabrina is on her feet too: "You agreed to take it — you're the team leader!"
strings.曹国栋翻着那台没电的手持 GPS，皱着眉头问：“出发前不是充满了吗？满电能撑两天: Gordon turns over the dead handheld GPS and frowns. "Wasn't this fully charged when we set out? A full charge lasts two days — how did it die in the afternoon?" Everyone looks at {actor}.
strings.曹国栋被赶出天幕的那天，一个人背着记录本往山脊走了。搜救队后来在一棵大树下找到他: The day Gordon Cao was driven out from under the tarp, he walked off toward the ridge alone with the record book. The searchers later found him beneath a big tree, the book wrapped in three plastic bags and tucked under his body.
strings.曹国栋还在跑外业，只是包里多了一样东西：一部卫星电话。新来的年轻人嫌沉，他就自己: Gordon Cao still does fieldwork, but his pack holds one more thing now: a satellite phone. The new young staff complain it's heavy, so he carries it himself.
strings.最后一点吃的摆在救生毯上：半个饵块、几块饼干、一小截火腿肠。所有人都饿。: The last of the food is laid out on an emergency blanket: half a rice cake, a few biscuits, a stub of sausage. Everyone is hungry.
strings.最后那点吃的，给了身体最好的那个人。: The last of it goes to the fittest among you.
strings.最后那点吃的，被塞到了最弱的那个人手里。: The last scraps are pressed into the weakest one's hands.
strings.最快的回暖办法；贴着的人会冷: The fastest way to rewarm; whoever holds you gets cold
strings.最快；绳子刚够长，湿崖滑得站不住脚，一失手就是二十米: The fastest way; the rope is only just long enough, the wet rock gives no footing, and one slip is a twenty-metre fall
strings.最省事；被丢下的人会记住你们: The easiest option; the man you leave behind will remember you
strings.最稳妥，搜救队迟早会来；可要等多久，谁也不知道: The safest bet; the searchers will come sooner or later — but nobody knows how long that will take
strings.有人二话不说，掀开衣服把那双冰凉的脚揣进了怀里。: Without a word someone lifts their clothes and tucks the icy feet against their stomach.
strings.有人光着膀子冲进雨里，咬着手电把绳子重新绑上了树。: Someone dashes out into the rain, torch clenched in their teeth, and lashes the line back to the tree.
strings.有人扯掉救生毯，把燃着的松明塞进柴堆底下。青枝噼噼啪啪地响，一柱白烟慢慢顶进了雾: Someone pulls off the cover and shoves burning fatwood under the stack. The green branches crackle, and a column of white smoke pushes slowly up into the fog.
strings.有人把自己的抓绒衣和冲锋衣都脱了下来，给{protagonist}套上。: Someone strips off their own fleece and shell and pulls them onto {protagonist}.
strings.有人睡着了，脸上挂着笑。: Someone falls asleep with a smile on their face.
strings.本地方言很重，爱说“老表”“莫要报上去嘛”“我晓得一条路”。: Heavy local dialect. Calls everyone "cousin", says "don't report me, eh" and "I know a path".
strings.朽木里掏出来的一把肥白虫子: A handful of fat white grubs dug out of a rotten log
strings.林子里“咔嚓”一声，一根碗口粗的枯枝从十几米高的树冠上砸了下来，正落在天幕边上。: A crack from somewhere above, and a dead branch as thick as a bowl crashes down from the canopy a dozen metres up, landing right at the edge of the tarp. Several more like it still hang overhead.
strings.林子里传来狗叫声和人声，越来越近。几个穿橙色衣服的人从箭竹林里钻了出来，领头的那: Barking and voices in the forest, getting closer. Several people in orange push out of the bamboo, and the one in front shouts into a radio: "Found them! They're here!"
strings.林学院研一的学生，第一次跟队出野外，负责记录植物名录。她穿着一件棉卫衣和一件一次: A first-year master's student in forestry on her first field trip, keeping the plant species list. She's wearing a cotton hoodie and a disposable rain poncho — nobody told her in advance what to bring into this forest.
strings.林窗里偶尔也会飘过来一格信号；很费电: Now and then a bar of signal drifts into the clearing; it eats battery
strings.林窗里又多了一圈红布条和一个更大的 SOS。: Another ring of ribbons and a bigger SOS go up in the clearing.
strings.林窗里用倒木摆的 SOS、树上的红色样地标记带、摊开的银色救生毯、烟。雨会把烟压: An SOS of fallen logs in the clearing, red survey ribbons on the trees, silver emergency blankets spread open, smoke. Rain flattens the smoke and fog hides everything.
strings.林窗里的 SOS 又加长了一倍，银色的救生毯在太阳底下亮得晃眼。: The SOS in the clearing doubles in length, and the silver blankets flash in the sun.
strings.林窗里的 SOS 摆好了，三个白色的大字母躺在苔藓上，从坡上往下看都很扎眼。: The SOS in the clearing is finished: three big white letters lying on the moss, glaring even from up the slope.
strings.林窗里的烽火堆垒好了，比人还高，盖着一块救生毯防雨。: The signal pyre in the clearing is finished, taller than a person, with an emergency blanket over it to keep off the rain.
strings.林窗里，信号格突然跳了一下！{actor} 手忙脚乱地发出了一条带坐标的短信——: In the clearing the signal bar flickers! {actor} fumbles out a text with the coordinates — and it sends.
strings.歌声停了。只剩下雨声。: The singing stops. Only the rain is left.
strings.气温：白天 6–12°C，夜里 0–3°C，冷锋过境时再低几度。林下风小，山脊上: Temperature: 6–12°C by day, 0–3°C at night, a few degrees colder when a cold front comes through. Little wind under the canopy, a lot on the ridges. Wet clothes make it feel 6°C colder, and at this humidity they won't dry overnight without a fire.
strings.气罐只剩半罐，用来生火，以后就没法烧开水、煮东西了: The canister is half empty; burn it for the fire and there'll be nothing to boil water or cook with later
strings.水不缺：天幕边上接的雨水、树叶上滴的雾水、坡下的溪水，有人顺手就灌满了。: Water is never short: rain off the tarp, fog drip from the leaves, the stream below — someone always fills the bottles.
strings.水到处都是，吃的却很少。越橘、橡子、朽木里的虫子能补一点；野生菌热量不高、风险很: Water is everywhere; food is not. Wild blueberries, acorns and grubs from rotten logs help a little. Wild mushrooms carry few calories and a lot of risk: death-cap symptoms only start 6–24 hours after the meal, then comes a false recovery, then liver failure; undercooked bluing boletes make people see "little people".
strings.水在离天幕一米的地方停住了，天亮前慢慢退了下去。没人睡着。: The water stops a metre from the tarp and slowly drops back before dawn. Nobody sleeps.
strings.水就在手边，搜救队也常沿着溪沟找；可溪边夜里更冷更潮，涨水时危险，往下走还可能碰: Water close at hand, and searchers often work along streams; but nights by the water are colder and damper, a flood is dangerous, and further down there may be a waterfall
strings.没找到样地线，却在一道梁子上看见了一片被踩倒的箭竹，地上还有干了的牛粪。: No sign of the plot line, but on one spur the arrow bamboo has been trampled flat and there's dried cow dung on the ground.
strings.活着走出林子的人是：{survivors}。留在雾里的是：{dead}。后来，搜: Those who came out of the forest alive: {survivors}. Those who stayed in the fog: {dead}. Later the search teams followed the red ribbons they had tied back into the mountains, and took them down one by one.
strings.消息一定能带到；营地里少一个能干活的人: The message is sure to get through; the camp loses a pair of working hands
strings.湿柴在石头上一排排摊开，冒着白汽。: The wet wood is laid out on the rocks in rows, steaming.
strings.湿柴的烟往天幕里倒灌，{actor}突然捂着胸口喘不上气，喉咙里像拉风箱一样呼哧: Smoke from the wet wood rolls back under the tarp and suddenly {actor} is clutching her chest, unable to breathe, wheezing like a bellows, lips turning blue in seconds.
strings.湿树枝压上去，火堆里腾起一股呛人的白烟，贴着树冠慢慢散开。: Wet branches go on and the fire belches acrid white smoke that creeps out under the canopy.
strings.溪水只拿来洗东西，喝的全是天幕边上接的雨水。: The stream is only for washing; every drink comes from rain collected at the edge of the tarp.
strings.溪水在前面忽然没了声音——走近了才看见，整条溪从一道二十多米高的石崖上跌了下去，: Ahead, the stream suddenly goes quiet — and up close you see why: the whole stream pours over a rock face more than twenty metres high into a pool of white foam. Both sides of the drop are thick with wet moss and bamboo. This is the cliff Alu warned about.
strings.溪水看着清亮，可上游的箭竹里有牛粪，阿鲁也说这一带有人放牛。烧开再喝，就得多烧柴: The stream water looks clear, but there's cow dung in the bamboo upstream, and Alu says people graze cattle round here. Boiling it means burning more wood; drinking it raw could mean diarrhoea.
strings.溪边一块大石头底下有人在喊“救命”，嗓子已经哑了。是个五十多岁的男人，右脚踝肿得: Someone is calling for help from under a big boulder by the stream, voice gone hoarse. It's a man in his fifties, his right ankle swollen like a bun, a small hoe and half a sack of muddy paris root lying beside him — digging paris root in the reserve is illegal. He says his name is Dennis Luo, he's been lying here three days, and he knows of a cattle trail to the east.
strings.滇中某原始森林自然保护区西坡（虚构）: Western slope of an old-growth forest reserve in central Yunnan (fictional)
strings.火堆里腾起一股白烟，被风吹得歪歪斜斜。: White smoke billows out of the fire and is blown about by the wind.
strings.火着了一会儿，又被湿柴压灭了，只烘干了一小捆柴。: The fire burns for a while, then the wet wood smothers it. One small bundle gets dried.
strings.火苗蹿起一人多高，{protagonist}的脸被映得通红，可还在发抖。: The flames leap higher than a person and {protagonist}'s face glows red in the light, still shaking.
strings.火被压成了一堆暗红的炭。: The fire is banked down to a heap of dull red embers.
strings.灯光在夜里比哨声传得远: At night a light carries further than a whistle
strings.烘干了、能直接烧的柴。篝火每 12 小时烧掉 1 捆。: Wood dry enough to burn. The campfire burns 1 bundle every 12 hours.
strings.烟少了，可今晚会冷一些: Less smoke, but a colder night
strings.烤了，大家分着吃: Roast it and share it out
strings.烧掉的那几页记录表，后来是曹国栋一个人背着仪器回去重测的。他在样地中心那棵树上钉: Gordon Cao went back alone with the instruments to re-measure the pages that had gone into the fire. On the tree at the centre of the plot he nailed a small aluminium tag engraved with nothing but a date.
strings.爬上山脊，打通一个电话: Get up on the ridge and get one call through
strings.爽快，不多问，手脚麻利。认得山上每一条牛路、每一个能躲雨的石洞。: Straightforward, asks few questions, quick with her hands. She knows every cattle path and every rock shelter on the mountain.
strings.牛场有火塘有窝棚，离寨子也近；可走不动的人怎么办: The pasture has a hearth and a shack, and the village isn't far beyond; but what about anyone who can't walk?
strings.牛场的火塘一直烧着，走到那里就好了。: The hearth at the pasture never goes out. Get there and you'll be all right.
strings.牛路就在东边那道梁子上，牛屎多的地方就是。: The cattle trail's on that spur to the east. Where you see a lot of dung, that's it.
strings.牛路总会通到牛场和寨子；可走路的人会湿、会累，晚上要在路上重新搭天幕: Cattle trails always lead to a pasture and a village; but walking means getting wet and tired, and pitching the tarp again on the way each night
strings.狗有力气，才能跟着大家走: A dog needs strength to keep up
strings.狗认得路，人认不得；可夜里少了一个暖和的身子: The dog knows the way when people don't — but there'll be one less warm body at night
strings.现在说这个没用，先想怎么出去: There's no point now — work out how to get out
strings.用掉 1 份引火物，看阿鲁的手艺；火着了，今晚就好过得多: Uses 1 unit of tinder and depends on Alu's skill; with a fire, tonight will be much easier
strings.用自己的体温去捂；抱着的人也会冷: Warm {protagonist.him} with your own bodies; whoever does it will get cold too
strings.用苏曼的气罐炉子烘干湿柴: Use Sabrina's gas stove to dry out the wood
strings.留下点吃的和一张救生毯，出去以后告诉搜救队他在这里: Leave him some food and an emergency blanket, and tell the searchers where he is
strings.留在大树底下，把信号做大，等人来找: Stay under the old tree, make the signals bigger, and wait to be found
strings.留着它，夜里它能给人取暖，还能看营地: Keep her — she keeps someone warm at night and guards the camp
strings.留着，真到了最后再说: Keep them for when it really comes to the end
strings.白天七八度，夜里一两度，雨和雾一直不散。在这片林子里，湿透的人不用等到结冰就会冻: Seven or eight degrees by day, one or two at night, and the rain and fog never lift. In this forest, a soaked person can die of cold long before anything freezes.
strings.白烟一直顶到了树冠上面。: The white smoke rises clear above the canopy.
strings.白秀英一个人朝东边的梁子走去。: Iris Bai sets off alone toward the eastern spur.
strings.白秀英一天一夜走下了山，把乡里的干部和搜救队带了上来。事后有人要给她送锦旗，她摆: Iris Bai walked down the mountain in a day and a night and brought the township officials and the search teams back up. Afterwards someone wanted to present her with a banner of thanks. She waved it away: "My cattle are still up the mountain. I have to get back."
strings.白秀英在前面踩出一串深深的脚印。: Iris Bai leaves a line of deep footprints ahead.
strings.白秀英在营地住了几夜，拖回来的柴比谁都多。今天早上她把察尔瓦一紧：“我下去，叫人: Iris Bai has spent a few nights in camp and dragged in more wood than anyone. This morning she pulls her cape tight: "I'll go down. Bring people up."
strings.白秀英把察尔瓦一裹，赶着牛消失在雾里。: Iris Bai wraps her cape tight and disappears into the fog with her cattle.
strings.白秀英没能回到牛场。她的牛自己下了山，一头一头走回了寨子。: Iris Bai never made it back to the pasture. Her cattle came down the mountain by themselves and walked back into the village one by one.
strings.白秀英牵着宋佳怡的手，朝东边的梁子走去。: Iris Bai leads Joy by the hand toward the eastern spur.
strings.白秀英说到做到，一天一夜走下了山，把搜救队带了上来。被接下山的人是：{survi: Iris Bai was as good as her word: she walked down the mountain in a day and a night and brought the search teams up. Those carried down: {survivors}. Those who didn't live to see it: {dead}. All that winter, around the hearths of the village on the eastern slope, people talked about it.
strings.白秀英走在最前面，用砍刀一刀一刀把箭竹劈开。“跟着我，莫怕。”: Iris Bai goes in front, hacking the bamboo aside stroke by stroke. "Follow me. Don't be afraid."
strings.白秀英那年冬天照样在牛场住到了下雪。开春她下山的时候，在西坡的垭口上系了一串红布: That winter Iris Bai stayed up at the pasture until the snow came, as she always did. When she came down in spring, she tied a string of red cloth strips at the pass above the western slope.
strings.直升机在林窗上空盘旋了一圈，扔下一个橙色的包：压缩饼干、急救包、一部对讲机。对讲: The helicopter circles once over the clearing and drops an orange pack: hardtack, a first-aid kit and a radio. A voice comes over it: "We see you. The ground team will reach you tomorrow."
strings.相信设备胜过相信人。脑子快，嘴也快，着急起来会钻牛角尖，认定的事九头牛都拉不回。: Trusts equipment more than people. Quick-witted and quick-tongued; when he's anxious he gets fixated, and once he's set on something nothing will shift him. Warm-hearted underneath, just not good at saying so.
strings.省事；可风还没停: Saves effort — but the wind hasn't dropped
strings.省力气；可在这片林子里，人要是乱走……: Saves everyone's strength; but in this forest, if someone wanders off…
strings.省林草调查规划院的高级工程师，跑了二十多年外业，这片保护区的样地有一半是他当年布: A senior engineer at the provincial forestry survey institute with more than twenty years of fieldwork behind him; he laid out half the survey plots in this reserve himself. He has brought the team in to finish the last three plots before the inspection at the end of the month.
strings.看不准的全扔，能吃的就少了三成；挑得准不准，看眼力: Anything doubtful gets thrown out, which costs a third of the pile; how well it's sorted depends on who's looking
strings.知道了自己在地图上的位置，就知道牛路和公路在哪个方向: Once you know where you are on the map, you know which way the trail and the road lie
strings.知道往哪走，开路就快些: Knowing which way to go makes opening the way quicker
strings.砍两根小树当杆，用天幕的绳子和外套绑成一副担架。有了它，走不了路的人也能被抬着下: Two saplings for poles, lashed together with tarp cord and jackets into a stretcher. With it, someone who can't walk can be carried down.
strings.硬着头皮指一个方向: Brace yourself and point one way
strings.离山下近一步；人会湿透、累垮，湿滑的石头上也容易摔: One step closer to the bottom; you'll get soaked and worn out, and the wet rocks are treacherous
strings.离开柴刀和手机再看，指针稳稳地指着北: Away from the machete and the phones, the needle points steadily north
strings.穿着，靠体温捂干: Keep it on and dry it with body heat
strings.站在天幕边上，每隔一阵吹三声哨子，用手电打三长三短。哨声在林子里能传一两里；要是: Stand at the edge of the tarp and every so often blow three blasts on the whistle and flash three long, three short with a torch. A whistle carries a kilometre or so through the trees; if searchers are nearby, they might hear. The torch costs a little battery.
strings.站曹国栋：近道是苏曼带的: Side with Gordon: Sabrina led you onto the shortcut
strings.站苏曼：是队长点的头: Side with Sabrina: the team leader said yes
strings.竹鼠烤得滋滋冒油，每个人分到了几口。: The rat sizzles over the fire and everyone gets a few mouthfuls.
strings.第九天早上，雾散了。搜救队找到了那块天幕，里面只有一个人还活着：{survivo: On the ninth morning the fog lifted. The searchers found the tarp, and under it only one person still alive: {survivors}. The others lay huddled together under every emergency blanket there was. Years later, {survivors} still won't go out in the rain.
strings.第九天早上，雾终于散了。一支搜救队顺着红布条找了过来，找到了那块天幕。被抬下山的: On the ninth morning the fog finally lifted. A search team followed the red ribbons and found the tarp. Carried down the mountain: {survivors}. Those who didn't live to see the day: {dead}.
strings.第二天下午，两个浑身是泥的人摸到了山下的一条运材道上，拦住了一辆拉木头的拖拉机。: The next afternoon two mud-caked figures stumble onto a logging road below and flag down a tractor hauling timber.
strings.第二天傍晚，阿黑一瘸一拐地跑进了寨子。阿鲁的老婆解下塑料袋，看了一眼纸条，抓起电: The next evening Blackie limps into the village. Alu's wife unties the plastic bag, glances at the note and grabs the phone to call the township.
strings.第二天早上，雾还是没散，坡下的溪沟一直在响。苏曼说：溪沟总会通到山下，顺着水走就: Second morning, and the fog still hasn't lifted; the stream keeps up its noise below. Sabrina says streams always lead down the mountain — follow the water and you'll get out. Alu shakes his head: on this mountain, following the water takes you to a cliff. Gordon says the protocol for being lost is to stay where you are.
strings.第二天，{actor} 开始拉肚子。: The next day {actor} comes down with diarrhoea.
strings.算了，先活着出去: Forget it. Getting out alive comes first
strings.管它是什么，跟着感觉走: Whatever it is, go by gut feeling
strings.箭竹从手里滑脱了。{actor} 一直滚到乱石堆里，左腿压在身子底下，弯成了一个: The bamboo slips through {actor.his} fingers. {actor} tumbles all the way into the boulders, left leg pinned underneath at a wrong angle.
strings.精明，爱讨价还价，嘴上不饶人，心里怕得要死——怕死在山里，更怕被林业派出所抓。: Shrewd, a haggler with a sharp tongue, terrified underneath — of dying on the mountain, and even more of being caught by the forest police.
strings.红布条从营地一直绑到了牛路上，岔口用树枝摆了一个大大的箭头。: Red ribbons now run all the way from camp to the trail, and at the junction there's a big arrow laid out in branches.
strings.纸是现成的，也是最干的；可那是曹国栋三天的调查数据: The paper is right there and it's the driest thing you have — but it's three days of Gordon's survey data
strings.纸条上写着：五个人，在西坡大石栎底下，有伤员，要人。下面是日期和曹国栋的签名。: The note says: five people, under the big stone oak on the western slope, injured among us, send help. Below, the date and Gordon Cao's signature.
strings.细心，怕给人添麻烦，难受也不说。书上的东西记得特别牢：哪种菌子有毒、哪种树皮能引: Careful, afraid of being a burden, never says when she's suffering. She remembers everything she reads — which mushrooms are poisonous, which bark will light — but she has never had to use any of it outdoors. Push her hard enough and she's the most stubborn of them all.
strings.终于可以下山了: At last you can go down the mountain
strings.给他一个自己说出来的机会: Give him the chance to say it himself
strings.给出衣服的人自己会冷: Whoever gives up their clothes will be colder for it
strings.给明天要去探路、拖柴的人: Give it to whoever is scouting or hauling wood tomorrow
strings.绳子一头绑在崖顶的大树上，人一个一个地往下放，每个人落地的时候，上面的人都松一口: One end of the rope is tied to a big tree at the top and people are lowered one at a time; each time someone touches down, everyone above breathes again.
strings.罗德胜一边骂一边把重楼一棵一棵埋回了溪边的土里。: Grumbling the whole time, Luo replants the paris root one by one in the soil by the stream.
strings.罗德胜松了一口气，拉着{actor}的袖子，把牛路的走法从头到尾说了一遍。: Luo lets out a breath, takes {actor} by the sleeve and goes through the way along the cattle trail from start to finish.
strings.罗德胜没能走出那片林子。他那袋重楼后来被搜救队带了出来，交给了保护站。: Dennis Luo never made it out of the forest. The searchers carried his sack of paris root out and handed it to the reserve station.
strings.罗德胜的口袋里有半袋重楼。{actor}是林草系统的人，按规定，在保护区里遇到盗: Dennis Luo has half a sack of paris root. {actor} works for the forestry service; the rules say poaching in the reserve has to be recorded and reported. Luo watches him, eyes full of pleading.
strings.罗德胜的脚踝打了钢钉。出院那天，林业派出所的人在门口等着他。那袋重楼被没收了，罚: Dennis Luo's ankle was pinned with steel. The day he left hospital the forest police were waiting at the door. The paris root was confiscated; he couldn't pay the fine, so he worked it off as a ranger at the reserve station for two years.
strings.罗德胜的脚踝打了钢钉，阴天会疼。他再也没进过保护区。他说，那几个人救了他一命，他: Dennis Luo's ankle was pinned with steel and aches when it rains. He never went into the reserve again. Those people saved his life, he says, and he owes the mountain one.
strings.羽绒服挂在火边冒着白汽，{actor}裹着救生毯缩成一团。: The jacket steams by the fire while {actor} huddles in an emergency blanket.
strings.翻朽木找虫子，摘越橘和野猕猴桃，捡石栎果，顺手找找能引火的松明子。东西不多，聊胜: Break open rotten logs for grubs, pick wild blueberries and kiwifruit, gather acorns, and keep an eye out for pine fatwood to use as tinder. Not much to be had, but better than nothing — and the undergrowth is crawling with land leeches.
strings.老实说：我只在小时候来过一回: Admit it: you only came here once, as a boy
strings.能动的人都围在火边砍杆子、绑绳子。: Everyone who can still move gathers by the fire to cut poles and lash cord.
strings.能多吃好几百千卡；里面要是混着毒菌……: Several hundred extra kcal; if anything poisonous is mixed in…
strings.能把湿柴引着的干东西：纸、松明子、固体酒精……火灭了以后，要靠它重新生火。: Anything dry that can get wet wood going: paper, pine fatwood, a fuel tablet… Once the fire dies, this is what you relight it with.
strings.能挡住多少风雨，今晚就少受多少罪: Every bit of wind and rain kept out is that much less suffering tonight
strings.能走的人先走出了林子，当天夜里就带着搜救队，顺着一路的红布条回去接走不动的人。第: Those who could walk came out of the forest first, and that same night they led the search teams back along the trail of red ribbons to fetch those who couldn't. By noon the next day everyone was down the mountain: {survivors}.
strings.脚印一直延伸到下游的乱石滩里。明天一早去找。: The prints lead away downstream into the boulders. First thing tomorrow, you'll go and look.
strings.脱下来挂在火边慢慢烘: Take it off and hang it by the fire to dry slowly
strings.自由摄影师，爬过很多山，受保护区委托来拍宣传片，跟着调查队进山。是她在一个户外轨: A freelance photographer who has climbed plenty of mountains, commissioned by the reserve to shoot a promotional film and tagging along with the survey team. She was the one who found the ridge "shortcut" on a hiking-track app and talked everyone into taking it — and into a detour for the sea of clouds.
strings.苏曼一个人坐到了天幕的另一头。: Sabrina goes and sits alone at the other end of the tarp.
strings.苏曼交了宣传片，片子里只有晴天的山——云海、杜鹃、阳光。她没拍到雾。她说，雾是拍: Sabrina Su delivered the promotional film: clear-weather footage only — sea of clouds, rhododendrons, sunlight. She never got the fog on camera. Fog, she says, can't be photographed.
strings.苏曼和邓一鸣商量好了：两个人轻装往下走，一天就能走出去叫人，比一群人拖着慢慢挪快: Sabrina and Ethan have it worked out: the two of them travel light, walk out in a day and fetch help — much faster than the whole group dragging along. Gordon says the first rule of search and rescue is never split up.
strings.苏曼在那条轨迹下面写了一条很长的评论，把那几天发生的事一件一件写了下来，最后一句: Sabrina Su left a long comment under that track describing everything that happened in those days, ending with: "Don't go. I did." The platform later took the track down.
strings.苏曼张了张嘴，最后点了点头。: Sabrina opens her mouth, then finally nods.
strings.苏曼没能走出来。她的相机后来被送回了工作室，里面有三百多张照片，最后几十张都是雾: Sabrina Su didn't make it out. Her camera was later returned to her studio with more than three hundred photos on it. The last few dozen are all fog, focused on something in it that can't be seen.
strings.苏曼被赶走以后，一个人顺着溪沟往下走。四天后，一个下山收菌子的村民在溪边捡到了她: After she was driven out, Sabrina Su went down the stream alone. Four days later a villager buying mushrooms found her camera by the water. The last frame on the card is a blank white field of fog.
strings.苏曼踢了一脚地上的柴，坐了回去。: Sabrina kicks at the firewood and sits back down.
strings.莫怕，牛都晓得回家，人也晓得。: Don't be afraid. Cattle know the way home. People do too.
strings.菌子没找着几朵，倒是摘了一捧越橘: Hardly any mushrooms, but a handful of wild blueberries
strings.营地里有几个人已经走不了路。: How many people in camp can no longer walk.
strings.被山洪卷走: swept away by the flash flood
strings.被树上掉下的断枝砸中: struck by a falling dead branch
strings.被洪水冲到石头上: slammed against rocks by the flood
strings.被风刮断的树枝砸中: struck by a branch torn off in the wind
strings.裤腿里钻进了七八条旱蚂蟥，血顺着袜子往下流: Seven or eight land leeches have crawled up a trouser leg; blood runs down into the socks
strings.要多钻一两天的箭竹林，人会湿透、累垮；但不用吊绳子: A day or two more of fighting through bamboo, wet and exhausted — but no rope
strings.要拿出一点吃的；大家心里会踏实一些: Costs a little food; everyone will feel steadier for it
strings.要是搜救队，就能听见: If it's the searchers, they'll hear
strings.要是能找到昨天走过的路，今天就能下山；找不到，大家白白湿透一身: If you can find yesterday's path you could be down today; if not, everyone gets soaked for nothing
strings.要用掉 1 捆湿柴；雾里的烟散不开，不一定看得见: Uses 1 bundle of wet wood; smoke doesn't rise well in fog, so it may not be seen
strings.要用掉一点吃的和水: Uses a little food and water
strings.要用掉半捆干柴；烘的这半天里，自己只能干冻着: Uses half a bundle of dry wood; while it dries, you'll just have to be cold
strings.要费电，人会淋湿，夜里也容易摔: Uses battery, you'll get soaked, and it's easy to fall in the dark
strings.要重新搭天幕，人会湿、会累: The tarp has to be pitched again; everyone gets wet and tired
strings.警觉，护主，见了生人先低吼。夜里会贴着人睡。: Alert and protective; growls at strangers first. At night she sleeps pressed up against people.
strings.认真、要强、说一不二，觉得这片山他比谁都熟。认一句错比挨一夜冻还难。可到了真要命: Meticulous, proud and used to having the last word; he's sure he knows these mountains better than anyone. Admitting a mistake is harder for him than a night in the cold. But when it really comes down to it, he'll take off his own fleece for one of the young ones.
strings.让{protagonist}大口喝水，把吐掉的补回来: Get {protagonist} to drink as much as possible to replace what's lost
strings.让他们俩去: Let the two of them go
strings.让他把重楼埋回去，就当没挖过: Have him replant the paris root and call it even
strings.让冻得最厉害的宋佳怡跟着她先下山: Send Joy, who's suffering worst from the cold, down with her
strings.让她一个人走，走得快: Let her go alone — she's faster that way
strings.让懂行的人一朵一朵挑过再煮: Have whoever knows mushrooms sort through them one by one first
strings.让火灭了吧，大家挤在一起熬到天亮: Let it go out and huddle together until dawn
strings.让身体最好的人跟她一起下去，路上互相照应: Send the fittest person with her so they can look out for each other
strings.记录本里有这棵树的坐标——算出我们在哪儿: The record book has this tree's coordinates — work out where you are
strings.话少，手巧，敬山神，从不跟山较劲。进林子先在大树下点一炷香、念几句。他信老辈人讲: Says little, good with his hands, respectful of the mountain spirits and never one to fight the mountain. Before entering the forest he lights incense under a big tree and murmurs a few words. He believes the old people's tales of the "bewitched hollow" where people walk in circles — but he trusts his machete more.
strings.语速快，爱说“理论上”“我算过了”“只要有一格信号就行”。: Talks fast. Likes "in theory", "I've done the maths" and "one bar of signal is all we need".
strings.说实话：电池早就老化了，我没报: Tell the truth: the battery was worn out and you never reported it
strings.说得过去；可心里清楚: It's plausible — but you know the truth
strings.说是冻的，低温下掉电快: Say it was the cold — batteries drain fast in the cold
strings.说话干脆，常说“相信我”“我走过比这难的”“别光坐着”。: Brisk. Says "trust me", "I've done harder than this" and "don't just sit there".
strings.说话轻，常带“老师说……”“书上写……”“我没事”。: Soft-spoken. Often says "my professor says…", "the book says…" and "I'm fine".
strings.说雾太大，等雾散了再看: Say the fog's too thick and you'll look again when it lifts
strings.请他别唱了，省点力气: Ask him to stop and save his strength
strings.请大家把火压小一点，别再烧湿柴: Ask everyone to bank the fire down and stop burning wet wood
strings.请她带着大家一起走去牛场: Ask her to lead everyone to the pasture
strings.请她留下来帮两天，等天好了再走: Ask her to stay and help for a couple of days until the weather improves
strings.请她马上下山报信: Ask her to go down and raise the alarm right away
strings.谁也不丢下；可每多等一天，就多冷一夜: No one gets left behind — but every extra day is another cold night
strings.谁也不多，谁也不少: Nobody gets more, nobody gets less
strings.谁也不用出去；可今晚大家都会湿: No one has to go out — but everyone gets wet tonight
strings.谁也不许走，要活一起活: Nobody goes. We live or die together
strings.调查队的小急救包：纱布、碘伏、弹力绷带、止痛片。: The team's small first-aid kit: gauze, iodine, an elastic bandage, painkillers.
strings.调查队的技术员，管 GPS、平板和对讲机，业余玩无人机。下个月回老家订婚，手机屏: The team's technician, in charge of the GPS, the tablet and the radios, and a drone hobbyist on the side. He's getting engaged back home next month; his phone's lock screen is a photo of his fiancée.
strings.赌水不会再涨，守着天幕: Bet the water won't rise any further and stay with the tarp
strings.赌赢了什么都不丢；赌输了……: Win the bet and you lose nothing; lose it and…
strings.走不了路的人，有担架就抬着；没有，就只能先留在营地，等走出去的人带救援队回来接: Anyone who can't walk goes on the stretcher if there is one; if not, they wait in camp until those who get out bring the rescuers back
strings.走了两个钟头，前面的树上绑着一条红布条——是你们自己昨天绑的。你们一直在绕圈子。: Two hours in, there's a red ribbon on a tree ahead — one you tied yourselves yesterday. You've been walking in circles.
strings.走出去了，大家都得救；走不出去，就是两个人在野外过夜: If they make it, everyone is saved; if not, it's two people spending the night in the open
strings.走出林子的那天傍晚，苏曼在水电站门口拍了一张照片：一排浑身是泥的人，背后是一堵浓: The evening they walked out, Sabrina Su took one photo at the gate of the hydropower station: a row of mud-caked people with a wall of fog behind them. It never made it into the promotional film. It hangs by the door of her studio.
strings.走到一道岔沟前，大家都等着{actor}拿主意。{actor}站了很久，左看看，: At a fork in the gully everyone waits for {actor} to decide. {actor} stands there a long time, looking left, then right, forehead streaming — rain or sweat, it's hard to say.
strings.走到天快黑，前面是一道断崖，只好原路退回。: By nightfall the way ends at a sheer drop, and you have to retrace every step.
strings.趁暴雨还没下来囤柴；人会湿透、累垮: Stock up before the downpour hits; you'll be soaked and worn out
strings.趁着天晴，把 SOS 和红布条再加大: While it's clear, make the SOS and the ribbons bigger
strings.趁雾还薄，往来的方向找样地线: While the fog is thin, head back the way you came to find the plot line
strings.越泡越烂: The longer it soaks, the worse it gets
strings.跑到林窗里挥衣服: Run into the clearing and wave clothes
strings.跟邓一鸣换着穿，他的软壳湿了也还保暖: Swap with Ethan — his soft shell still keeps some warmth when wet
strings.踩上一根长满青苔的倒木，滑下去扭了脚: Stepped onto a moss-covered log, slipped off and turned an ankle
strings.躲到上风口去，咬牙忍着，不说: Move upwind and fight through it without telling anyone
strings.躺在太阳底下，好好歇一会儿: Lie in the sun and get some proper rest
strings.过上一夜一天就会好；看着的人睡不成觉: It wears off in a day and a night; whoever watches gets no sleep
strings.还在大树底下的时候：在营地周围转一转，找样地线、找人走过的痕迹、找牛路。营地挪到: While camped under the old tree: circle the camp looking for the plot line, any sign of people, a cattle trail. Once the camp is by the stream (or you've found the cattle trail): go ahead and open the way, checking whether the next stretch can be walked; each trip pushes the way down further. Slick, steep and foggy — easy to fall.
strings.还是留在原地: Stay where you are after all
strings.这一夜有几个人在吹哨、打手电。: How many people are blowing whistles and flashing lights tonight.
strings.这一带是菌子窝：鸡油菌、牛肝菌、青头菌……也有长得一模一样的毒菌。采回来的菌子先: These woods are full of mushrooms — chanterelles, porcini, green russulas… and poisonous ones that look exactly the same. Whatever you pick is set aside; whether it goes in the pot is for everyone to decide.
strings.这个季节菌子快过了，转了一大圈只找到几朵烂的: The season is almost over; a long round turns up only a few rotten ones
strings.这个雾，要下三天。: This fog will sit for three days.
strings.这么清的水，直接喝: Water this clear — just drink it
strings.这只脚怕是废了。废了就废了，人要活着。: This foot's probably done for. So be it. A man has to live.
strings.这片林子我走了二十年，从来没见过这么大的雾。: Twenty years I've walked this forest. Never seen fog like this.
strings.这种时候，安静点好: Better to keep quiet at a time like this
strings.这里海拔两千七百多米。白天七八度，夜里一两度，雨和雾一阵一阵，没有停的意思。气温: You are at about 2,700 metres. Seven or eight degrees by day, one or two at night, and the rain and fog come in waves with no sign of stopping. It isn't freezing — but in this forest, once you are soaked through, the cold works its way into your bones a little at a time.
strings.退回去，从旁边的梁子上绕过去: Go back and detour over the spur beside it
strings.邓一鸣二话没说，把软壳脱了下来。: Ethan takes off his soft shell without a word.
strings.邓一鸣借苏曼的手机看离线轨迹，想找出昨天走岔的地方。轨迹下面的评论区还缓存着一条: Ethan borrows Sabrina's phone to look at the offline track, hoping to find where you went wrong. The comments under the track are still cached, including this one: "Two people got lost on this stretch last year and it took three days to find them. Don't go." Posted three months ago.
strings.邓一鸣把手机还给了苏曼，什么也没说。: Ethan hands the phone back to Sabrina without a word.
strings.邓一鸣没能下山。他的未婚妻收到了一条迟到了好几天的短信，是他在山脊上发出、一直卡: Ethan Deng never came down. His fiancée received a text days late — one he had sent from the ridge that sat stuck on "sending": "Don't worry, we'll be back soon."
strings.邓一鸣的订婚推迟了一个月。他后来辞了职，去一家做户外安全设备的公司搞研发，做的第: Ethan Deng's engagement was put off by a month. Later he quit and joined a company that makes outdoor safety gear; the first thing he built was a location beacon that lasts three days below freezing.
strings.邓一鸣被赶走以后，一个人往山脊爬去找信号。人们后来在山脊上找到了他的手机，电量是: After he was driven out, Ethan Deng climbed toward the ridge alone to look for signal. His phone was later found up there with a dead battery; when someone charged it, the lock screen still showed that photo.
strings.那一格信号虽然只有二十几秒，{actor}的手机却一下子涌进来十几条短信。其中一: That one bar of signal lasted barely twenty seconds, but a dozen texts flood into {actor}'s phone. One is from the institute office, sent three days ago: "Gordon, we've forwarded you the county's cold-wave warning. Please take care, and suspend fieldwork if necessary."
strings.那天夜里，林窗里的手电光一直在闪：三长，三短，三长。: All that night the torch flashes in the clearing: three long, three short, three long.
strings.那是一支搜救队在喊。他们等了一会儿，没听见回应，往另一条沟去了。: It was a search team calling. They waited a while, heard no answer, and moved on to another gully.
strings.那条近道的轨迹下面有一条评论：“去年有两个人在这一段迷路，搜救找了三天，别走。”: Under that shortcut track there was a comment: "Two people got lost on this stretch last year and it took three days to find them. Don't go." You read it and paid it no mind. Your pack also holds five energy bars and a bar of chocolate, and you haven't told anyone.
strings.那边也响起了哨声！一长两短，又一长两短——是搜救队！: A whistle answers! One long, two short, and again — it's the searchers!
strings.那边又叫了一声，短促、沙哑——阿鲁听出来了：“麂子。”: It calls again, short and hoarse. Alu knows the sound: "Muntjac."
strings.那通二十几秒的电话，后来被搜救指挥部的人反复听了很多遍。邓一鸣如期订了婚，酒席上: That twenty-odd-second call was played over and over at search headquarters. Ethan Deng got engaged as planned. At the banquet someone asked him about the mountain; all he said was, "There happened to be one bar of signal on the ridge that day."
strings.都闭嘴，吵架暖不了身子: Both of you, enough — arguing won't warm anyone
strings.采回来的菌子摊在天幕底下：金黄的、褐色的、白的，堆了一小堆，闻着很香。饿了好几天: The mushrooms are spread out under the tarp — golden, brown, white — a little heap that smells wonderful. People who have been hungry for days can't take their eyes off it.
strings.采回来的菌子里有多少见手青——不炒熟会致幻。: How many bluing boletes are among the mushrooms picked — hallucinogenic unless cooked through.
strings.采回来的菌子里混着几朵致命的。: How many deadly mushrooms are mixed in with the ones picked.
strings.采回来还没下锅的菌子。能吃的、有毒的，混在一起。: Mushrooms picked but not yet cooked. The edible and the poisonous, all mixed together.
strings.重楼长得慢，七年才长一指头。我晓得不该挖，可是娃娃要读书嘛。: Paris root grows slow — seven years for a finger's length. I know I shouldn't dig it, but the kids need schooling, eh.
strings.钻进天幕，省着力气熬过去: Get under the tarp and save your strength
strings.钻进救生毯，让人贴着身子捂: Get into an emergency blanket with someone, skin to skin
strings.银色的一面朝天；热成像对着空地才看得见人，要淋一身湿: Silver side up; a thermal camera only sees people out in the open, and you'll get soaked
strings.锅和饭盒敲得叮当响，哨子吹得刺耳。: Pots and lunchboxes clang and whistles shriek.
strings.锅里咕嘟咕嘟地冒着泡，菌子的香味飘满了天幕。每个人都喝了两碗汤。: The pot bubbles away and the smell of mushrooms fills the tarp. Everyone has two bowls of broth.
strings.问清楚牛路在哪，就走: Find out where the cattle trail is, then go
strings.阿鲁从背篓底下抽出那捆松明，劈下几片，一点就着。松脂的味道冲得人直流眼泪。: Alu pulls the bundle of fatwood from the bottom of his basket, splits off a few slivers and lights them with one strike. The smell of resin makes everyone's eyes run.
strings.阿鲁再也没给外面的人当过向导。女儿的学费，是他去州里的工地上搬了两个月砖挣出来的: Alu never guided outsiders again. He earned his daughter's school fees carrying bricks on a building site in the prefecture town for two months. If anyone asks about the western slope, he says: "I don't know that side."
strings.阿鲁后来在西坡的溪沟口立了一块木牌，用彝文和汉字写着：往上走，莫跟着水。牌子第二: Alu later put up a wooden sign where the stream comes out of the western slope, in Yi script and Chinese: Going up? Don't follow the water. A flood took it the next year. He put up another.
strings.阿鲁回到寨子，杀了一只鸡祭山神。调查院把工钱一分不少地打了过来，还多出一千块，备: Back in the village, Alu killed a chicken as an offering to the mountain spirit. The institute paid his wages in full, plus an extra thousand yuan marked "guide's fee". He sat by the hearth holding the payment slip for a long time.
strings.阿鲁把一小块腊肉放在树根上，念了很长一段彝话。念完，他说：“好了，山神晓得我们在: Alu sets a small piece of cured pork among the roots and recites a long passage in Yi. When he's done he says, "There. The mountain spirit knows we're here."
strings.阿鲁拍了拍阿黑的屁股，喊了一声彝话。阿黑回头看了一眼，钻进了雾里。: Alu slaps Blackie's rump and calls out something in Yi. She looks back once, then vanishes into the fog.
strings.阿鲁摸着阿黑的头说：“它认得回寨子的路。把纸条装进塑料袋绑在它脖子上，让它回去报: Alu strokes Blackie's head. "She knows the way back to the village. Put a note in a plastic bag, tie it round her neck and send her home with the message." But it means crossing several ridges; she could get lost and never come back.
strings.阿鲁没能回到寨子。按彝家的规矩，人死在外面，魂要有人去山里喊回来。他的女儿去了，: Alu never made it back to the village. By Yi custom, when someone dies away from home, someone must go to the mountains and call the soul back. His daughter went. She stood at the gate of the reserve and called his name three times.
strings.阿鲁背了一小捆，是留着自己回程用的；用了就没了: Alu brought a small bundle for his own trip home; once it's used, it's gone
strings.阿鲁被赶走的那天，吹了一声口哨，阿黑就跟着他走进了雾里。三天后，他一个人回到了东: The day Alu was driven out he gave one whistle and Blackie followed him into the fog. Three days later he walked back into his village on the eastern slope alone — he knew the way home after all, just not that forest.
strings.阿鲁说，这是寨子里送人出远门时唱的，意思是：走多远都要回来。: Alu says it's what the village sings when someone sets off on a long journey. It means: however far you go, come home.
strings.阿黑再也没有回来。阿鲁每年开春上山放牛，都会在西坡的垭口上喊几声它的名字。: Blackie never came back. Every spring when Alu takes the cattle up the mountain, he calls her name a few times from the pass above the western slope.
strings.阿黑叼着它那一半，躲到天幕角落里啃得咔嚓响。: Blackie takes her half to a corner of the tarp and crunches away at it.
strings.阿黑是自己跑回寨子的，瘦了一圈，脖子上的塑料袋里还装着那张纸条。后来寨子里的人说: Blackie found her own way back to the village, a good deal thinner, the note still in the plastic bag around her neck. When people in the village talk about it now, they call her "the dog who carried the message".
strings.阿黑没能回到寨子。阿鲁说，它最后是朝着家的方向躺着的。: Blackie never made it home. Alu says that at the end she was lying facing home.
strings.阿黑没跟着阿鲁回来。阿鲁把它的项圈挂在火塘上方的竹竿上，挂在腊肉旁边。: Blackie didn't come home with Alu. He hung her collar on the bamboo pole above the hearth, next to the cured pork.
strings.阿黑脖子上的那张纸条，让搜救队一下子把范围缩到了西坡的一道沟里。被找到的人是：{: The note round Blackie's neck let the search teams narrow everything down to one gully on the western slope. Those found: {survivors}. Those who couldn't hold on: {dead}.
strings.阿黑趴回了宋佳怡的脚边。: Blackie lies back down at Joy's feet.
strings.阿黑跟着阿鲁回了寨子。第二年春天，它下了一窝小狗，全是黑的。: Blackie went home with Alu. The next spring she had a litter of puppies, every one of them black.
strings.阿黑钻进箭竹林里，半天没出来。回来的时候嘴里叼着一只肥嘟嘟的竹鼠，放在阿鲁脚边，: Blackie disappears into the bamboo for a long while. She comes back with a plump bamboo rat in her jaws, drops it at Alu's feet and wags her tail.
strings.随{protagonist}去，过几个钟头就好了: Leave {protagonist} be — it'll pass in a few hours
strings.雨停了，云压在树梢上，林子里稍微亮了一些。: The rain has stopped. Cloud sits on the treetops and the forest is a little lighter.
strings.雨细得像雾，不知不觉就把衣服浸透了。: Rain so fine it's almost mist, soaking through your clothes before you notice.
strings.雾浓得看不清十步以外的树，树叶上的水滴个不停，走一圈下来浑身都是湿的。: The fog is so thick you can't see a tree ten paces off, and the leaves drip without end; one walk through the undergrowth and you're wet through.
strings.雾越走越浓，什么也没找到，只好顺着自己的脚印退了回来。: The fog thickens with every step. Finding nothing, you follow your own footprints back.
strings.雾里传来一阵铃铛声，叮当、叮当。几头黄牛从箭竹里挤了出来，后面跟着一个披着羊毛察: Bells sound in the fog — clank, clank. A few yellow cattle shoulder out of the bamboo, followed by a Yi woman in a woollen charwa cape. She looks you over and asks in halting Mandarin, "You — lost?" Her name is Iris Bai, and she herds cattle at the pasture to the east. She tips out every buckwheat cake and piece of cured pork in her basket.
strings.顺手采了一兜菌子，黄的白的褐的都有: A bagful of mushrooms picked along the way — yellow, white and brown
strings.顺溪下山：溪沟最后总会通到山下，可半路常有瀑布和陡崖，湿滑的石头上摔一跤就可能骨: Following the stream down: streams do end up in the valleys, but on the way there are waterfalls and cliffs, and one slip on wet rock can break a leg. Stay and wait for rescue, or walk out on your own — there is no right answer.
strings.顺着溪沟或牛路往山下走了多远。到 100%，就能走到山下的路上。: How far you've worked your way down along the stream or the cattle trail. At 100% you reach a road below.
strings.顺着脚印去找那个人: Follow the footprints and find whoever made them
strings.预警短信的事写进了事故调查报告。曹国栋被撤了队长，调去管档案。他没有申辩，只是每: The warning text went into the accident report. Gordon Cao was removed as team leader and moved to the archives. He didn't argue. Every November he takes a few days' leave, and nobody knows where he goes.
strings.领头的队员说，是阿黑脖子上那张纸条，让他们把搜索范围缩到了这面坡上。: The lead searcher says it was the note round Blackie's neck that narrowed the search down to this slope.
strings.风突然转了向，林子里的雾被吹得一团一团往坡上涌，树冠哗哗作响。阿鲁抬头看了看天，: The wind swings round without warning. The fog is driven up the slope in clots and the canopy roars. Alu looks up at the sky and his face changes: "Cold wind's coming. A big one."
strings.马上拆天幕往坡上撤: Strike the tarp and get up the slope right now
strings.马上爬出去，把它重新绑好: Crawl out right now and tie it back down
strings.麂子叫起来是很像人: A barking deer really can sound like a person
strings.黑熊一般怕人: Black bears are usually afraid of people
strings.黑熊人立起来晃了晃脑袋，转身钻回了林子。: The bear rears up, swings its head, then turns and crashes back into the forest.
strings.黑熊在十几米外撕开袋子，吃得吧唧吧唧响，天快亮了才走。: A dozen metres away the bear tears the bag open and eats noisily until nearly dawn, then leaves.
strings.黑熊在营地边上转了两圈，嗅了半天，走了。: The bear circles the camp twice, sniffing for a long time, then goes.
strings.黑熊没走，扑过来叼起装吃的袋子就跑，大家眼睁睁地看着。: The bear doesn't leave. It lunges in, snatches the food bag and runs, while everyone watches helplessly.
strings.黑熊翻吃的时候，一爪子扫在了 {actor} 的背上。: Rooting for the food, the bear swipes a paw across {actor}'s back.
strings.（阿黑一整夜都朝着坡下的方向趴着。）: (All night long, Blackie lies facing downhill.)
strings.（阿黑叼回来一根树枝，放在火堆边，摇着尾巴。）: (Blackie brings back a stick, drops it by the fire and wags her tail.)
strings.（阿黑抖了抖湿透的身子，甩了旁边的人一脸水。）: (Blackie shakes out her soaked coat and sprays everyone nearby.)
strings.（阿黑竖起耳朵，冲着雾里低低地叫了两声。）: (Blackie pricks up her ears and gives two low barks into the fog.)
strings.（阿黑钻进天幕，挤在宋佳怡脚边，把下巴搁在她的鞋上。）: (Blackie squeezes in under the tarp beside Joy and rests her chin on Joy's shoe.)
